title: Amarnath Ji Yatra via Pahalgam 5 Nights 6 Days Spiritual Journey
name: Amarnath Ji via Pahalgam Tour Package
page_title: Amarnath Ji Yatra via Pahalgam – 5 Nights 6 Days Spiritual Journey
description: Embark on a divine adventure with our 5 Nights 6 Days Amarnath Ji Yatra via Pahalgam. Begin your journey in Srinagar, trek through picturesque landscapes from Pahalgam to Sheshnag, Panchtarni, and the holy Amarnath Cave. Return to Srinagar for local sightseeing, exploring iconic attractions, and conclude with a memorable departure. Book this perfect blend of spirituality and natural beauty now!

itinerary.title: Day 01 | (Pahalgam)Srinagar to Pahalgam
itinerary.text: Arrive at Srinagar airport, where our representative meets you for the drive to Pahalgam (about 95 km, 3 hours). On the way you pass saffron fields at Pampore and the Avantipur temple ruins. Pahalgam lies in the Lidder valley and is the base for the yatra route via Chandanwari. After checking in at your hotel, the evening is free to walk along the Lidder river and prepare for the trek. Overnight stay in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Day 02| Phalgam to Chandanwari to Sheshnag
itinerary.text: Distance: 16 kms+trek*13 kms Driving Time (App.): 6-7hrs. Leave Pahalgam (Valley of Shepherds) drive for Chandanwari. Pahalgam is the best base for most of the treks. Chandanwari (2896 Mts.) is a small shut off vale, at the junction of Sheshnag stream and the stream for Astanmarg. On arrival to Chandanwari, trek to Sheshnag which is about 13 kms (3576 Mts.). The trial climbs the Pissu Ghati and then climbs gradually to the Sheshnag Lake. Sheshnag is one of the windiest places in this valley. . Dinner and overnight stay in tents at Sheshnag.

itinerary.title: Day 03 | Sheshnag to Panchtarni to Amarnath to Panchtarni
itinerary.text: Distance: Trek*17kms +DARSHAN OF HOLY CAVE+trek*6kms Start trek from Sheshnag to Panchtarni (3657 Mts.) The walk is through Mahagunas Pass (3200 Mts), and then a gradual walk to Panchtarni. Further trek Panchtarni to Amarnath cave. Amarnath is only 6 kms away from Panchtarni. Have a dip in the ice-cold water of Amarnath Stream, which flows, outside the cave. Inside the cave there is scenery of calm tranquility of white and glistering three massive Lingmas stand erect symbol of Lord Shiva, Parvathi and Ganesh. Later trek back towards Panchtarni. Dinner and overnight stay in Panchtarni.

itinerary.title: Day 04 | Panchtarni to Chandanwari to Phalgam to Srinagar
itinerary.text: After darshan, trek down from Panchtarni to Chandanwari along the yatra route. At Chandanwari our vehicle meets you for the drive back to Srinagar via Pahalgam (about 110 km). In Srinagar, transfer to your houseboat on Dal Lake, a peaceful place to rest after the trek. Dinner and the overnight stay are on the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Day 05 | Srinagar Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text: Morning sightseeing of Mughal Gardens visiting Nishat Bagh (Abode of pleasure, built by Asif Khan brother in law of Jehangir in 1632 A. D) And Shalimar Bagh (Abode of love built by Jehangir fro his wife Empress Noor Jehan). All the gardens are situated on the bank of Dal Lake with the Zabarwan Mountains in the background. Enroute visit carpet - weaving factory. After lunch Shikara ride on Dal Lake visiting floating and vegetable gardens etc. Dinner and overnight stay in Deluxe Houseboats.

itinerary.title: Day 06 | Srinagar Departure
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your houseboat or hotel. Depending on your plans, our driver transfers you to Srinagar airport for your flight to Jammu or Delhi. If you prefer to travel by road, you can instead leave early for Jammu (about 300 km, 9 hours) to board your train at Jammu railway station. The yatra ends here, with the blessings of Baba Barfani.

Begin your journey in Srinagar, travel to Sonamarg, and take a helicopter ride for the holy Amarnath Darshan. Explore Srinagar's iconic attractions and enjoy a day trip to the mesmerizing Gulmarg. itinerary.title: Day 01 : Srinagar – Sonmarg (By Road, 83 Kms, 3 /4 Hours)
itinerary.text: You are picked up at Srinagar airport or bus stand for the drive to Sonmarg (about 83 km, 3–4 hours). The road follows the Sindh river through green valleys and pine forests. After checking in at your hotel, the rest of the day is free to rest, walk in the meadow and prepare for the yatra. Sonmarg sits at around 2,690 m, so take it easy on the first day. Overnight stay in Sonmarg.

itinerary.title: Day 02 : Sonamarg – Neelgrat – Panjtarni – Neelgrat – Sonamarg – Srinagar
itinerary.text:
Early morning catch the helicopter from Neelgrat Helipad to Holycave. (The Helicopter stops 5 kms away from Holy cave since past 4 years.) Proceed for Darshan of Holy Amarnath ji and return back to Neelgrat by Helicopter and you will be drive back to Srinagar. Arrive and check in hotel. Overnight in Srinagar.
(In case you got stuck in Panjtarni, Due to weather conditions or any other problem, you will be staying at Panjtarni at your own)

itinerary.title: Day 03 : Srinagar: (By Road, 83 Kms, 3 /4 Hours)
itinerary.text:
(If you stuck last night at panjtarni, then arrive neelgrat by morning and drive to Srinagar, Arrive and check in hotel).
This morning after breakfast proceed to visit The City of Srinagar. The world famous Mughal Gardens visiting the Nishat Bagh (The garden of pleasure) and Shalimar Bagh (Abode of love), The Chasme Shahi Garden, Shankaracharya Temple, In the Evening Shikara ride on The Dal Lake to enjoy the beauty of the Charchinar, Floating Gardens & the God has graced this city with, which is often compared to Venice. You will get view of some very interesting places around the Lake. Stay overnight at Hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 04 : Srinagar – Gulmarg – Srinagar (56 km)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, set out for a full-day excursion to Gulmarg (about 56 km each way), a meadow resort surrounded by snow-capped peaks. Enjoy the open meadows on foot or by pony. You can ride the Gondola cable car from Gulmarg towards Khilanmarg at your own cost, for close views of the mountains. In the evening, drive back to Srinagar for the overnight stay at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 05 : Srinagar – Departure
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel. Depending on your flight time, you may have a little time for last-minute shopping in Srinagar. Our driver then picks you up from the hotel and drops you at Srinagar airport for your flight home. The yatra ends here, with the blessings of Baba Barfani.

title: Amritsar with Dalhousie Dharamshala
name: Amritsar with Dalhousie Dharamshala
page_title: Amritsar with Dalhousie Dharamshala 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Explore the cultural and natural beauty of North India with our 5-day Amritsar, Dalhousie, and Dharamshala tour. Discover the Golden Temple in Amritsar, enjoy the scenic landscapes of Dalhousie, and experience the spiritual ambiance of Dharamshala.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Amritsar)Amritsar to Wagah Border and Local sightseeing
itinerary.text: Arrive Amritsar, transfer to hotel and check in. Visit the Golden Temple and later visit the massacre of Jalian Wallan Bagh. Afternoon little free time to rest and evening around 3 PM drive to Wagah Border to see the Closing Ceremony, event starts exactly by 5.30 PM everyday. Border closing 'lowering of the flags' ceremony is a daily military practice that the security forces of India and Pakistan.This ceremony takes place every evening before sunset at the Wagah border, which as part of the Grand Trunk Road was the only road link between these two countries before the opening of the Aman Setu in Kashmir in 1999. The ceremony starts with a blustering parade by the soldiers from both the sides and ends up in the perfectly coordinated lowering of the two nations flags, it is called the beating retreat border ceremony on the international level. One infantryman (Jawan) stands at attention on each side of the gate. As the sun sets, the iron gate at the border is opened and the flags are lowered. The flags are folded and the ceremony ends with a retreat that involves a brusque handshake between soldiers from either side. Return back to Hotel and Overnight

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Dalhousie)Amritsar to Dalhousie - Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Amritsar to Dalhousie (about 210 km, 6 hours). Dalhousie is a hill station spread over five hills, with colonial-era churches and views of the Dhauladhar range. After checking in at your hotel, visit the local sights such as Gandhi Chowk, the Subhash Baoli spring and St. John's Church, and stroll along the Mall. Overnight stay in Dalhousie.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Dalhousie)Dalhousie Local Sightseeing - Khajjiar Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Khajjiar (about 24 km), a wide green meadow ringed by deodar forests, with a small lake and the Khajji Nag temple. It is often called the "mini Switzerland of India". Enjoy the mountain views from Lakkar Mandi on the way. Optional activities such as pony rides and zorbing are paid locally. Return to Dalhousie in the evening for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Dharamshala)Dalhousie to Dharamshala Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text:
Check out and drive to Mc Leodganj (Dharamsala), magnificently set to the background of the Dhauldhar mountains and the seat of his Holiness, the Dalai Lama, the leader of the Tibetans, since 1960. On arrival check in at hotel. Evening visit Dal Lake, Church, Bhagsu Nag Temple and Tibetan Monastery. Overnight at hotel.
Dalhousie to Dharamshala distance 120 Kms, 3-4 Hours drive by road

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Dharamshala)Dharamshala to Amritsar Drop (230 Kms, 6 Hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Dharamshala and drive back to Amritsar (about 230 km, 6 hours) through the Kangra valley and the plains of Punjab. Depending on your travel time, you can stop for a last visit to the Golden Temple. Our driver then drops you at Amritsar airport or railway station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

itinerary.text: Arrive Amritsar, transfer to hotel and check in. Visit the Golden Temple and later visit the massacre of Jalian Wallan Bagh. Afternoon little free time to rest and evening around 3 PM drive to Wagah Border to see the Closing Ceremony, event starts exactly by 5.30 PM everyday. Border closing 'lowering of the flags' ceremony is a daily military practice that the security forces of India and Pakistan.This ceremony takes place every evening before sunset at the Wagah border, which as part of the Grand Trunk Road was the only road link between these two countries before the opening of the Aman Setu in Kashmir in 1999. The ceremony starts with a blustering parade by the soldiers from both the sides and ends up in the perfectly coordinated lowering of the two nations flags, it is called the beating retreat border ceremony on the international level. One infantryman (Jawan) stands at attention on each side of the gate. As the sun sets, the iron gate at the border is opened and the flags are lowered. The flags are folded and the ceremony ends with a retreat that involves a brusque handshake between soldiers from either side. Return back to Hotel and Overnight.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Dalhousie)Amritsar to Dalhousie - Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Amritsar to Dalhousie (about 210 km, 6 hours). Dalhousie is a hill station spread over five hills, with colonial-era churches and views of the Dhauladhar range. After checking in at your hotel, visit the local sights such as Gandhi Chowk, the Subhash Baoli spring and St. John's Church, and stroll along the Mall. Overnight stay in Dalhousie.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Dalhousie)Dalhousie Local Sightseeing - Khajjiar Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Khajjiar (about 24 km), a wide green meadow ringed by deodar forests, with a small lake and the Khajji Nag temple. It is often called the "mini Switzerland of India". Enjoy the mountain views from Lakkar Mandi on the way. Optional activities such as pony rides and zorbing are paid locally. Return to Dalhousie in the evening for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Dharamshala)Dalhousie to Dharamshala Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text:
Check out and drive to Mc Leodganj (Dharamsala), magnificently set to the background of the Dhauldhar mountains and the seat of his Holiness, the Dalai Lama, the leader of the Tibetans, since 1960. On arrival check in at hotel. Evening visit Dal Lake, Church, Bhagsu Nag Temple and Tibetan Monastery. Overnight at hotel.
Dalhousie to Dharamshala distance 120 Kms, 3-4 Hours drive by road

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Dharamshala)Dharamshala - Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, set out on a full-day excursion to two of the 51 Shaktipeeths: the Jwalamukhi Temple, known for its eternal flames, and the Chintpurni Temple. On the way, visit Kangra town and, if time allows, the old Kangra Fort. Return to Dharamshala in the evening. Overnight stay in Dharamshala.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Chandigarh)Dharamshala to Chandigarh (280 Kms, 9 Hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Dharamshala to Chandigarh (about 280 km, 8–9 hours). After checking in at your hotel, visit the Rock Garden, the sculpture garden created by Nek Chand from recycled materials, and Sukhna Lake, a favourite spot for an evening walk. Chandigarh, planned by Le Corbusier, is known for its wide, green avenues. Overnight stay in Chandigarh.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Chandigarh)Chandigarh to Delhi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Chandigarh. If time allows, visit the Rose Garden before leaving. Then drive back to Delhi (about 250 km, 4–5 hours). Our driver drops you at the railway station or airport in Delhi for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

description: Explore Shimla and Manali with our 6-night, 7-day travel package. Enjoy guided tours to Solang Valley, Rohtang Pass, Kufri, and historic landmarks in Shimla. Book your unforgettable Himachal adventure today!

itinerary.title: Day 1 : Delhi to Shimla by overnight Volvo
itinerary.text: In the late evening, board your Volvo coach from Delhi for the overnight journey to Shimla (about 350 km). Your seat is included in the package; the bus timing and boarding point are mentioned on your ticket. The comfortable air-conditioned coach lets you rest on the way so that you reach the hills early in the morning. Overnight journey on the bus.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Shimla)Arrival in Shimla and sightseeing
itinerary.text: Arrive in Shimla early in the morning; our representative meets you and transfers you to your hotel. After lunch, explore the town: the Viceregal Lodge (built in 1888), Christ Church (1844), the Gaiety Theatre, Scandal Point and the Kali Bari temple. The evening is free to walk along the Mall Road and the Ridge, with views over the valleys and plenty of cafés and shops. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Shimla)Shimla – Kufri – Shimla
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Kufri (about 16 km), known for the Himalayan Nature Park and its wide views of the snow peaks. Pony and yak rides are optional and paid locally. After lunch, visit the Jakhu Temple and other places in and around Shimla, then spend the evening on the Mall Road. Sightseeing is by car on a sharing basis. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Manali)Shimla to Manali (about 260 km / 8 hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive to Manali (about 260 km, 8 hours). On the way, see Sundernagar lake, the Pandoh dam on the Beas river and the Hanogi Mata temple, then drive through the Kullu valley with its orchards and river gorges. On arrival in Manali, check in at your hotel. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Manali)Solang Valley or Rohtang Pass excursion
itinerary.text: After breakfast, set out on an excursion to Solang Valley, known for its views of glaciers and snow peaks and for activities such as paragliding and ropeway rides (optional, paid locally). Alternatively, depending on the season and permits, you can visit Rohtang Pass up to the snow point at your own cost. Return to your hotel in Manali in the evening. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Manali)Manali sightseeing and Volvo to Delhi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and visit Manali's sights: the Hadimba Devi temple in its cedar forest, the Tibetan monastery, Vashisht village with its hot springs, and the Mall Road for shopping. In the evening, board your Volvo coach from Manali for the overnight journey back to Delhi. Overnight journey on the bus.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : Arrival in Delhi
itinerary.text: Your overnight Volvo reaches Delhi in the morning at the bus stand where you boarded. From here you continue your onward journey on your own, with memories of Shimla, Kufri, Manali and Solang Valley. Our services end on arrival in Delhi. Thank you for travelling with us.

title: Blissful Tour to Himachal Pradesh
name: Blissful Tour to Himachal Pradesh
page_title: Blissful Tour to Himachal Pradesh 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Experience the best of Himachal Pradesh with our 4-night, 5-day tour. Explore Amritsar, Chandigarh, and Shimla, including visits to iconic landmarks and scenic spots. Book your blissful Himachal getaway today

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Amritsar)Amritsar Arrival
itinerary.text: Arrive at Amritsar Railway Station and meet your travel companion. You will be transferred to the hotel. Check in hotel and the day is for leisure. Later in the evening visit Indo-Pak Wagah Border to watch Flag Retreat Ceremony- Wagah, an army outpost on Indo-Pak border 30 Kms from Amritsar where the daily highlight is the evening "Beating the Retreat" ceremony. Soldiers from both countries march in perfect drill, going through the steps of bringing down their respective national flags. Once the ceremony ends, you will be transferred back to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Chandigarh)Amritsar - Chandigarh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Amritsar and drive to Chandigarh (about 230 km, 5 hours). After checking in at your hotel and resting for a while, visit the city's best-known sights if time permits: the Rock Garden, created by Nek Chand from recycled materials, the Rose Garden and Sukhna Lake, a good place for an evening walk. Overnight stay in Chandigarh.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Shimla)Chandigarh – Shimla
itinerary.text: After Breakfast check out from the hotel for transfer Shimla. After checking in hotel and rest for a while. Shimla the former summer capital of British India, set amidst the snow capped Shivalik Mountains which offers some of the most stunning views of the mighty Himalayas. Enroute visit Pinjore Gardens or Ropeway at Timber Trail, Parwanoo. Arrive and check into the hotel. Evening free to stroll on The Mall and the famous Ridge. Ridge is famous for its stunning vistas of the valley and the Christ Church which is the most photographed landmark of Shimla. Dinner and Overnight in the hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Shimla)Shimla
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Jakhu Temple, set on Shimla's highest peak and dedicated to Lord Hanuman, with wide views of the Shivalik ranges. Then drive to Kufri, where you can be photographed in local Pahari dress and try pony or yak rides at your own cost. Return to Shimla for an evening on the Mall Road. Dinner and overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Shimla)Departure from Shimla
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Shimla. Take a last look at the hills before our driver takes you down to Delhi (about 350 km, 8–9 hours). On arrival, you are dropped at the airport or railway station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

description: Explore the enchanting beauty of Srinagar, Gulmarg, and Pahalgam with our 7-day tour package. Discover serene landscapes, snow-capped mountains, and cultural richness in this unforgettable Kashmir journey.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Leh)Leh Arrival
itinerary.text: Arrive at Leh's Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport, where our representative meets you and transfers you to your hotel. Leh is at about 3,500 m, so the rest of the day is for rest and acclimatisation, with welcome tea or coffee at the hotel. In the evening, if you feel well, visit the Shanti Stupa for sunset views over Leh, then stroll through the market. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Leh)Leh-Excursion to Monastries
itinerary.text: Post Breakfast we proceed for Indus Valley Monastery Starting with Hemis Gompa, the largest monastic foundation of Drukpa Kagyu Order of Tibetan Buddhism, Thiksey Monastery an impressive complex rising tier upon tier on a hill above the village, Shey Palace, The ancient capital of Ladakh, 3 Idiots Rancho School & Sindhu Ghat. After visiting above places drive back to Leh. Evening at leisure to explore the city on your own. Dinner & Overnight at the Hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Leh)Leh-Khardungla Pass-Leh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive up to Khardung La (about 40 km from Leh), one of the highest motorable passes in the world at around 5,300 m. Spend a short time at the top for photographs; do not stay long because of the altitude. Return to Leh in the afternoon and spend the rest of the day at leisure, perhaps in Leh market. Depending on your flight time, you may have a little time for last-minute shopping in Leh market for pashmina, apricots or Tibetan handicrafts. The departure transfer to Leh airport is included. The tour ends here, with memories of the monasteries and high passes of Ladakh.

title: Char Dham yatra Package from delhi for 11 Days
name: Char Dham Tour Package
page_title: Char Dham Yatra from Delhi - 10 Nights/11 Days Spiritual Journey
description: A 10-night, 11-day Char Dham Yatra from Delhi. Drive to Haridwar, then visit Yamunotri from Barkot, Gangotri from Uttarkashi, Kedarnath as a day visit from Guptkashi (trek or helicopter option), and Badrinath, returning via Rudraprayag to Haridwar and Delhi.

itinerary.title: DAY 01 Delhi to Haridwar (230 kms/6-7hrs) HT : 314 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Arrival Delhi Airport / Delhi Railway Station, Meet & Assist further drive to Haridwar. Transfer to your Hotel. If time permits visit Mansa Devi Temple, Chandi Devi Temple, Daksha Mahadev Temples & Others. Also visit Har-ki-Pauri for Ganga Aarti. The ‘Aarti’ worship of the Ganga after sunset and the floating ‘dia’ (lamp) is a moving ritual. Back to your hotel, Night halt.
Distance – 230 KM
Time – 6-7 Hours

itinerary.title: DAY 02 Haridwar to Barkot (210kms/7-8hr) HT : 1352 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Drive to Barkot via Mussoorie, En route visit Mussoorie Lake and Kempty Fall (Suggestible to have your lunch at Kempty fall as further no good restaurants are available before Badkot). Later drive straight to Barkot, transfer to your Hotel. The rest of the day is free to relax and store your energy for the Pahad (hill) Yatra of Yamunotri the next day. Overnight stay at Barkot.
Barkot Weather: Generally pleasant in summer, the temperature ranges from 25-30 degree Celsius, Winter: The Days are pleasantly cool but the nights are cold,temp ranges from 10 deg to 05 deg.
Distance – 210 KM

itinerary.title: DAY DAY 03 Barkot to Yamunotri to Barkot {36kms drive & 6kms Trek (one side)} HT : 3291 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Early morning, Drive to Jankichatti/Phoolchatti, trek start from here to Yamunotri (6kms). Either by walk or by horse or by Doli at own cost. The trek passes through lush green valley, a profusion of conifers, rhododendrons, cacti and several species of Himalayan shrubs.
Arr. Yamunotri, One can cook rice by packing it in a cloth and dipping it in the hot water of the hot kund. Pilgrims take this cooked rice home as “Prasad”. Here near the temple “Pooja” can be offered to Divya Shila, After taking bath in Jamunabai Kund’s warn water and having “Darshan” of pious “Yamunaji” returning to Jankichatti. Return back to Barkot, Overnight stay.
Yamunotri Temple: – Maharani Gularia of Jaipur built the temple in the 19th Century. It was destroyed twice in the present century and rebuilt again. At Yamunotri, One can cook rice by packing it in a cloth and dipping it in the hot water of the Tapt kund. Pilgrims take this cooked rice home as “Prasad”. Here near the temple “Pooja” can be offered to Divya Shila.
Surya Kund – There are a Number of thermal springs near temple, which flows into numerous pools. The most important of these is Surya Kund.
Yamunotri Weather – – In summer the maximun temp is 18 degrees and the minimum is 10 degrees celsius. The days are pleasantly cool but the nights are cold.
Distance – 36kms drive & 6kms Trek (one side)

itinerary.title: DAY 04 Barkot to Uttarkashi (100kms/4hr) HT :1352 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Morning after breakfast, drive to Uttarkashi. Check into the hotel arrival in Uttarkashi. Visit Kashi Vishwanath Temple in Uttarkashi. Overnight stay at Uttarkashi.
Uttarkashi is home to a number of ashrams, temples. The name of the town reflects its similarity to and location (as north of) the city of Kashi (Varanasi). Similar to Varanasi, the town of Uttarkashi is also situated on the banks of River Ganga.
Vishwanath Temple – – Vishwanath temple is one of the oldest Shiva temples in Northern India. Re-constructed in 1857 by Maharani Khaneti Devi of Tehri State in the ancient architectural style. It is situated at the heart of the town. A massive iron trident, symbolic of divine mother’s, is erected and worshiped from time immemorial at the temple complex. Ganeshji, Sakshi Gopal, Markandeya Rishi’s small shrines are also part of the temple complex. Akhand Jyoti as well as Akhand Abhishek, special aarti in morning and evening are offered. As per Skanda Puran, Uttarkashi is known as ‘Saumya Varanasi’, the abode of Lord Shiva in Kaliyug, and counted as one of the twelve Jyotirlingas.
Shakti Temple – Right in front of the Vishwanath temple is Shakti temple. It has a big ‘Trishul’ of about 6 meters in height and a circumference of 90 cms. at bottom. Though there are different views about the making of this, the upper part of it seems to be made up of iron and the lower one is of copper. As per the epics, this Shakti was thrown on the devils by the Goddess Durga(Shakti), hence it gets its name. Since then this Shakti is erected over here.
Uttarkashi Weather – Generally hot in summer, the temperature ranges from 30-35 degree Celsius but nights is pleasant, Cold in winters.
Distance – 100 KM
Time – 4 Hours

itinerary.title: DAY 05 Uttarkashi to Gangotri to Uttarkashi (100kms/3-4 each side) HT : 3048 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Early morning (packed breakfast) drive to Gangotri, en route at Gangnani take a holy dip in Garam Kund, further drive to Gangotri via beautiful Harsil Valley. Harsil is famous for its natural beauty and for the majestic views of the Deodar trees and mountains. On arrival at Shree Gangotri, take a holy dip in the sacred river Ganges which is also called Bhagirathi at its origin. Perform Pooja and Darshan, after that relax for some time in the lovely surroundings. Later drive back to Uttarkashi. Overnight stay at Uttarkashi.
Gangotri Temple - The temple was constructed by the Gorkha General Amar Singh Thapa in the 18th Century, is situated on the right bank of Bhagirathi.
Gangotri Weather - The maximum temperature during summer can go up to 20° Celsius. Summer nights can get cooler with a minimum temperature of 10° Celsius. Light woolen clothes are required while visiting Gangotri during summer. The Winter season is very chilly in Gangotri. Gangotri will be covered in sheets of snow during winter. Pilgrim centers remain closed throughout winter due to heavy snowfalls.
Distance – 100 KM
Time – 3-4 Hours

itinerary.title: DAY 06 Uttarkashi to Guptkashi (220kms/8-9hr) HT : 1319 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Morning after breakfast, drive to Guptkashi via Moolgarh & Lambgoan. En route, you can see the beautiful river Mandakini at Tilwara. The Mandakini river comes from Kedarnath, drive alongside the river to reach Guptakashi, visit Ardh Narishwar Temple in Guptakashi. Check into the hotel arrival in Guptakashi. Overnight stay at Guptakashi.
Guptakashi - The name Gupt Kashi means “Hidden Benares. Mythology describes how when the Pandava brothers were searching for a glimpse of Shiva, Shivji first concealed himself at Guptkashi, but later fled from them further up the valley to Kedarnath, where the Pandavas finally got their wish fulfilled.
Guptkashi Weather Pleasant in summer, the temperature ranges from 25-30 degree Celsius. Cold in winters.
Distance – 220 KM
Time – 08 - 09 Hours

itinerary.title: DAY 07 Guptkashi to Kedarnath to Guptkashi (30kms by road & 19kms Trek one way) Height: 3384 MTS.
itinerary.text:
By Helicopter: Morning our driver will transfer you your prebook Helipad. After Back our car will drop you at Hotel for rest. (note: helicopter ticket is not included in this package).
By Trek - Though it is difficult to go up and down from Sonprayag on the same day by trek. But it can be done if you take ponies or a helicopter while going to Kedarnath. Do coordinate well with the driver, as due to parking issue driver cannot stay at Sonprayag also network issue is also there.
Kedarnath - The Kedarnath shrine, one of the 12 jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva, is a scenic spot situated, against the backdrop of the majestic Kedarnath range. Kedar is another name of Lord Shiva. According to legend, the Pandavas after having won over the Kaurava in the Kurukshetra war felt guilty of having killed their own brothers and sought the blessings of Lord Shiva for redemption. He eluded them repeatedly and while fleeing took refuge at Kedarnath in the form of a bull. On being followed he dived into the ground, leaving his hump on the surface. The remaining portions of Lord Shiva appeared at four other places and are worshipped there as his manifestations. The arms appeared at Tungnath, the face at Rudranath, the belly at Madhmaheshwar, and his locks (hair) with the head at Kalpeshwar. Kedarnath and the four above-mentioned shrines are treated as Panch Kedar.
Kedarnath Weather - Due to its high altitude the weather in Kedarnath remains cold for the most part of the year. Summer here is cool and pleasant while winter is severe. During the summer season, the temperature varies around 20°Celsius. Light woolen wear is recommended. The Winter season in Kedarnath is severe with the mercury falling to as low as 0°Celsius. During this time the place experiences snowfall as well. Due to the extreme climatic conditions, this time is usually avoided by tourists.
Distance – 30kms by road & 19kms Trek one way

itinerary.title: DAY 08 Guptkashi to Badrinath (215kms/7hr) HT : 3133 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Morning after breakfast, drive to Badrinath. Check in to the hotel arrival in Badrinath. Pilgrims after having a bath in the Taptkund have the Darshan of Badrivishal & Aarti in the evening. Brahamakapal is significant for Pinddan Shraddh of ancestors (Pitrus). There is another interesting sightseeing spot like Mana, Vyas Gufa, Maatamoorti, Charanpaduka, Bhimkund, and the “Mukh” of the Saraswati River. Just within the three km of Badrinathjee. Overnight stay at Badrinath.
Mana Village : Inhabited by an Indo-Mongolian tribe, it is the last Indian village before Tibet.
Vasundhara : As the name suggests, Vasundhara is a magnificent waterfall. This place is 5km. from Badrinath out of which 2km. is motorable upto Mana.
Bhim Pul : On the other side of Mana village, a massive rock forming a natural bridge, lies over the roaring Saraswati river. It presents a spectacular view of water thundering down through the narrow passage under the rock and is believed to have been placed there by Bhim, the second eldest among the five Pandava brothers.
Vyas Gufa (cave) : Near Mana Village, this is a rock-cave where Ved Vyas is believed to have composed the Mahabharata and the pauranic commentaries.
Badrinath Weather: The average maximum temperature will be around 18° Celsius and the average minimum is 8° Celsius. Warm and woolen clothes are hence required for a stay in Badrinath throughout the year. Winter in Badrinath is often accompanied by snowfalls. itinerary.title: DAY 01 Delhi to Haridwar (230 kms/6-7hrs) HT : 314 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Arrival Delhi Airport / Delhi Railway Station, Meet & Assist further drive to Haridwar. Transfer to your Hotel. If time permits visit Mansa Devi Temple, Chandi Devi Temple, Daksha Mahadev Temples & Others. Also visit Har-ki-Pauri for Ganga Aarti. The ‘Aarti’ worship of the Ganga after sunset and the floating ‘dia’ (lamp) is a moving ritual. Back to your hotel, Night halt.
Distance – 230 KM
Time – 6-7 Hours

itinerary.title: DAY 02 Haridwar to Barkot (210kms/7-8hr) HT : 1352 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Drive to Barkot via Mussoorie, En route visit Mussoorie Lake and Kempty Fall (Suggestible to have your lunch at Kempty fall as further no good restaurants are available before Badkot). Later drive straight to Barkot, transfer to your Hotel. The rest of the day is free to relax and store your energy for the Pahad (hill) Yatra of Yamunotri the next day. Overnight stay at Barkot.
Barkot Weather: Generally pleasant in summer, the temperature ranges from 25-30 degree Celsius, Winter: The Days are pleasantly cool but the nights are cold,temp ranges from 10 deg to 05 deg.
Distance – 210 KM

itinerary.title: DAY 03 Barkot to Yamunotri – Barkot {36kms drive & 5 kms Trek (one side)} HT : 3291 MTS.
itinerary.text: Early in the morning, drive to Janki Chatti (about 36 km), from where the trek to Yamunotri begins (about 6 km one way). You can walk, or hire a pony or doli at your own cost. The path climbs through a green valley with conifers, rhododendrons and Himalayan shrubs. At Yamunotri, take a dip in the hot springs at Surya Kund and have darshan of Yamuna Ji. Trek back to Janki Chatti and drive to Barkot for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: DAY 04 Barkot to Uttarkashi (90kms/4hr) HT :1352 MTS.
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive from Barkot to Uttarkashi (about 90 km, 4 hours) along the valleys of the Yamuna and then the Bhagirathi. After checking in at your hotel, visit the Kashi Vishwanath Temple and the Shakti Temple with its ancient trident. The rest of the day is at leisure to rest before Gangotri. Uttarkashi is warm by day in summer and pleasant at night. Overnight stay in Uttarkashi.

itinerary.title: DAY 05 Uttarkashi to Gangotri to Uttarkashi (100kms/3-4 each side) HT : 3048 MTS.
itinerary.text:

Harsil is famous for its natural beauty and for the majestic views of the Deodar trees, and mountains. On arrival at Shree Gangotri, take a holy dip in the sacred river Ganges which is also called Bhagirathi at its origin. Perform Pooja and Darshan, after that relax for some time in the lovely surroundings. Return back to Uttarkashi. Overnight stay at Uttarkashi.
Distance – 100 KM
Time – 3-4 Hours

itinerary.title: DAY 06 Uttarkashi to Guptkashi (220kms/8-9hr) HT : 1319 MTS.
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive from Uttarkashi to Guptkashi (about 220 km, 8–9 hours) via Moolgarh and Lambgaon. After checking in at your hotel, visit the Ardh Narishwar Temple in the evening. Overnight stay in Guptkashi.

itinerary.title: DAY 07 Guptkashi to Kedarnath (30kms by road & 19kms Trek)
itinerary.text:
Morning after breakfast departure for Kedarnath Dham. Enjoy Kedarnath Darshan & back your hotel. Overnight stay at Kedarnath.
By Helicopter: Morning our driver will transfer you your prebook Helipad. You can inform the driver about your arrival time whether it will by helicopter or by trek, so that Driver will be there to pick you up. (note: helicopter ticket is not included in this package).

There is big parking issue so the driver will back tp another palace if his contact no. is not working then you have to arrange another taxi or wait for your driver.
Distance – 30 KM By Road & 19 KMs Trek

itinerary.title: DAY 08 Kedarnath to Guptkashi(19Kms Trek & 30kms/1hr by Road)
itinerary.text:

Distance – 19Kms Trek & 30kms/1hr by Road

itinerary.text:

Winter is very chilly with an average temperature of 5° Celsius. Due to the extreme climatic conditions, this time is usually closed for tourists.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Uttarkashi)Barkot to Uttarkashi (85 Km/ 3 Hours Journey).
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of the hotel in Barkot and drive to Uttarkashi (about 85 km, 3 hours) along the Yamuna and Bhagirathi valleys. After checking in, explore this town on the banks of the Bhagirathi, known for its temples and ashrams. In the evening, visit the Kashi Vishwanath Temple. Dinner and overnight stay in Uttarkashi.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Uttarkashi)Uttarkashi to Gangotri to Uttarkashi (100 Km / 3 to 4 Hours)
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, drive to Gangotri (about 100 km, 3–4 hours). On the way, stop at Gangnani for a dip in the hot springs. At Gangotri, take a holy dip in the Bhagirathi, as the Ganga is called at its source, and visit the Gangotri Temple for darshan and puja. In the late afternoon, drive back to Uttarkashi. Dinner and overnight stay in Uttarkashi.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Guptkashi)Uttarkashi to Guptkashi (240 Km / 9 to 10 Hours)
itinerary.text: Depart for your next destination, Guptkashi after having your breakfast early in the daybreak. On reaching, check-in to the hotel. Guptkashi is placed at a distance of 47 km from the holy shrine, Kedarnath. The town holds immense religious importance as it houses well-known ancient temples like Vishwanath Temple and Ardhnareshwar Temple. Have your dinner and stay overnight in the hotel or camp

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Kedarnath)Guptkashi to Sonprayag to Kedarnath (30 Km + 20 Km trek)
itinerary.text: Early in the morning, after breakfast, check out and drive to Sonprayag (about 30 km). From here the trek to Kedarnath begins (about 18–20 km one way from Gaurikund); ponies, palkis and helicopter seats can be booked at your own cost. The path follows the Mandakini river up to the temple at about 3,580 m. On arrival, check in at the government camps or lodges. Dinner and overnight stay at Kedarnath.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Guptkashi)Kedarnath to Sonprayag to Guptkashi / Rudraprayag (20 Km trek + 30 Km / 52 Kms drive)
itinerary.text: Early sunrise you get up before dawn and after taking bath you are at the temple by 4:45 am for the 'Abhishek' to Kedarnath Shiva. After darshan and puja you come out of the temple and go back to the Govt. Camps / Lodges. Afterward you will begin the go back trek of 20 km from Kedarnath to Sonprayag. The vehicles wait for you in Sonprayag Car Parking and drive to your hotel (Guptkashi / Rudraprayag). Dinner and Overnight at Guptkashi / Rudraprayag

itinerary.title: Day 9 : (Badrinath)Rudraprayag / Guptkashi to Joshimath to Badrinath (190 Km 0r 240 Kms / 8to 9 Hours)
itinerary.text: This sunrise, you check out of the hotel at 08:00 am and drive to Badrinath via Joshimath. After having your breakfast in the daybreak, check out of the hotel and start driving towards your next destination, Badrinath through Joshimath. On the arrival check in to the hotel. Next to go to Tapt Kund, take bath and after that go to the temple. Devoted to Lord Vishnu, the temple of Shri Badrinath Ji. Afterward back to hotel. Dinner and Overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 10 : (Rudraprayag)Badrinath to Joshimath to Rudraprayag / Birahi / Srinagar (165 Km / 5 to 6 Hours)
itinerary.text: This sunrise, visit Badrinath Temple for Darshan. Later, go back to the hotel for breakfast. After breakfast, you can leave for going to places of interest at Badrinath such as Mana Village, Vyas Gufa, Ganesh Gufa, and Mata Murti temple. In the daylight, check out from the hotel and head towards Rudraprayag through Joshimath. On the way visit Karanprayag. Rudraprayag holds great spiritual importance. Also, the town features stunning natural attractiveness and tranquility. On reaching Rudraprayag, check-in to the hotel. You can relax for the rest of the day or travel around the loveliness of Rudraprayag. Have your dinner and stay overnight at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 11 : (Haridwar)Birahi / Srinagar / Rudraprayag to Rishikesh to Haridwar (160 Km / 5 to 6 Hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive down from Rudraprayag to Rishikesh, known as the yoga capital of the world. Visit the Ram Jhula and Lakshman Jhula suspension bridges over the Ganga and the temples and ashrams nearby. In the evening, continue to Haridwar (about 25 km) and check in at your hotel. Dinner and overnight stay in Haridwar.

itinerary.title: Day 12 : (Delhi)Haridwar to Delhi (230 Km / 6 to 7 Hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, it is the last day of your Char Dham Yatra. Check out and drive back to Delhi (about 230 km, 6–7 hours). Our driver drops you at the railway station or airport in Delhi for your onward journey. The yatra ends here, with the blessings of Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath.

title: Chardham Yatra By Helicopter Tour
name: Chardham Yatra By Helicopter Tour
page_title: Chardham Yatra By Helicopter Tour 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Experience the spiritual journey of a lifetime with our Char Dham Yatra by helicopter. Visit Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath with ease and comfort, ensuring a hassle-free pilgrimage.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Dehradun)Dehradun Airport - Dehradun Hotel
itinerary.text: Arrive at Dehradun's Jolly Grant Airport, where our driver meets you and transfers you to your hotel in Dehradun by Innova. After checking in, the rest of the day is free to rest and prepare for the helicopter yatra, which begins early the next morning. Our team briefs you on the schedule, baggage limits and what to carry. Overnight stay at the Lemon Tree hotel in Dehradun.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Kharshali)Dehradun – Kharshali – Yamunotri – Kharshali
itinerary.text:
07:00 Am - Dehradun Helipad start your fly.
Passengers are requested to reach state government helipad on Sahastradhara Road, Dehradun which is the starting and ending point of this yatra. Vehicles are arranged for pick up.
Our pilots and ground staff will brief the guest about the entire trip and do’s and don’ts. Breakfast wilzl be arranged at Kharsali and passengers are supposed to leave their hotel early at Dehradun/Haridwar.
Upon arrival at Kharsali (The helipad for Yamunotri) passengers are welcomed by Haliyatra + Chardham Helicopter (HA), ground staff, who will unload their baggage and carry it to your hotel.
Temple is a 6 KMS trek which will be cover by palki. Total journey will take approx. 5 hour 30 min.
Generally passengers will return to hotel by lunch time. After rest, we do visit to Shani Temple which is near to your Hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Harsil)Kharshali - Harsil - Gangotri – Harsil
itinerary.text:
07:45 Am – Kharshali Helipad.
08:30 Am - Arrival at Harsil Helipad.
Harsil is one of the most beautiful and picturesque valleys in Uttrakhand an also known as mini Switzerland. Gangotri temple is approx MS22 K from Harsil helipad and drive by car is approx. 50 mins.Stay at Harsil is arranged at Himalayan Nature Resort which is around 2 KMS from helipad. Our ground staff will assist passengers throughout there stay at Harsil. We provide all the basic and leisure facilities for the tourists such as a premium accommodation with ensuite washrooms, delicious vegetarian food, short walks, local sightseeing and an evening bonfire in Gangotri Valley

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Guptkashi)Harsil - Kedarnath – Guptkashi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, fly by helicopter from Harsil towards Kedarnath, one of the twelve Jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva, set at about 3,580 m beneath snow peaks. After darshan at the Kedarnath temple, fly on to Guptkashi, where you stay the night. All transfers on this package are by helicopter, as listed in the inclusions, with ground support at each helipad. Overnight stay in Guptkashi.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Badrinath)Guptkashi – Badrinath
itinerary.text:
10:00 Am – Departure Guptkashi
11:00 Am - Arrival at Badrinath Helipad.
Badrinath has an average elevation of 3,100 metres. According to legend Shankara discovered a black stone image of Lord Badirnarayan made of Saligram stone in the Alaknanda River.
After arrival, passengers can check in to Hotel Snow crest which is close to temple. In evening, we do Visit of mana village which is near to religious site of Badrinath.
The special Maha Abhishek Pooja is the highlight of this entire yatra. It starts at 0400AM sharp in the morning and last for 02 hours. We have arranged an opportunity for our entire guest to sit inside the temple and cherish the darshan of the Shringar of the deity from close quarters.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Dehradun)Badrinath Dehradun Helipad Dehradun Airport
itinerary.text: After an early darshan at the Badrinath temple, dedicated to Lord Vishnu, fly by helicopter from Badrinath back to the Dehradun helipad. From the helipad, you are transferred to Dehradun airport for your onward flight. The helicopter Char Dham Yatra ends here, with the blessings of Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath.

title: Char Dham yatra Package from Haridwar for 9 Days
name: Char Dham Tour Package
page_title: Char Dham Yatra from Haridwar - 9 Nights/10 Days Spiritual Journey
description: An 8-night, 9-day Char Dham Yatra from Haridwar. Visit Yamunotri from Barkot, Gangotri from Uttarkashi, Kedarnath as a day visit from Guptkashi (trek or helicopter option), and Badrinath, returning via Rudraprayag to Haridwar.

itinerary.title: DAY 01 Haridwar to Barkot (210kms/7-8hr) HT : 1352 MTS
itinerary.text:
Pickup from Haridwar Railway Station / Dehradun Airport / Railway Station. Drive to Barkot via Mussoorie, En-route visit Kempty Fall (Suggestible to have your lunch at Kempty fall as further no good restaurants are available before Badkot). Later drive straight to Barkot, transfer to your Hotel. The rest of the day is free to relax and store your energy for the Pahad (Hill) Yatra of Yamunotri the next day. Overnight stay at Barkot.
Barkot Weather – Generally pleasant in summer, the temperature ranges from 25-30 degree Celsius, Winter: The Days are pleasantly cool but the nights are cold, temp ranges from 10 deg to 05 deg.
Distance – 210 KM
Time – 7-8 Hours

itinerary.title: DAY 02 Barkot to Yamunotri to Barkot {36kms drive & 6 kms Trek (one side)} HT : 3235 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Early morning after breakfast (packed breakfast), drive to Jankichatti / Phoolchatti & star trek from here to Yamunotri (6kms) (Either by walk or by horse or by Doli at own cost). After taking bath in Jamunabai Kund’s warm water and having “Darshan” of “Yamunaji” return to Jankichatti by trek. Later drive towards Barkot, Overnight stay at Barkot.
Yamunotri Temple: Maharani Gularia of Jaipur built the temple in the 19th Century. It was destroyed twice in the present century and rebuilt again. At Yamunotri, One can cook rice by packing it in a cloth and dipping it in the hot water of the Tapt kund. Pilgrims take this cooked rice home as “Prasad”. Here near the temple “Pooja” can be offered to Divya Shila.
Yamunotri Weather: In summer the maximun temp is 18 degrees and the minimum is 10 degrees celsius. The days are pleasantly cool but the nights are cold.
Distance – 36kms drive & 6 kms Trek (one side)

itinerary.title: DAY 03 Barkot to Uttarkashi (100kms/4hr) HT :1352 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Morning after breakfast, drive to Uttarkashi. Check into the hotel arrival in Uttarkashi. Visit Kashi Vishwanath Temple in Uttarkashi. Overnight stay at Uttarkashi.
Uttarkashi – is home to a number of ashrams, temples. The name of the town reflects its similarity to and location (as north of) the city of Kashi (Varanasi). Similar to Varanasi, the town of Uttarkashi is also situated on the banks of River Ganga.
Vishwanath Temple – Vishwanath temple is one of the oldest Shiva temples in Northern India. Re-constructed in 1857 by Maharani Khaneti Devi of Tehri State in the ancient architectural style. It is situated at the heart of the town. A massive iron trident, symbolic of divine mother’s, is erected and worshiped from time immemorial at the temple complex. Ganeshji, Sakshi Gopal, Markandeya Rishi’s small shrines are also part of the temple complex. Akhand Jyoti as well as Akhand Abhishek, special aarti in the morning and evening are offered. As per Skunda Puran, Uttarkashi is known as ‘Saumya Varanasi’, the abode of Lord Shiva in Kaliyug, and counted as one of the twelve Jyotirlingas.
Uttarkashi Weather – Generally hot in summer, the temperature ranges from 30-35 degree Celsius but night is pleasant, Cold in winters.
Distance – 100 KM
Time – 4 Hours

itinerary.title: DAY 04 Uttarkashi to Gangotri to Uttarkashi (100kms/3-4 each side) HT : 3048 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Early morning drive to Gangotri, en route at Gangnani take a holy dip in Garam Kund, further drive to Gangotri via beautiful Harsil Valley. Harsil is famous for its natural beauty and for the majestic views of the Deodar trees, and mountains. On arrival at Shree Gangotri, take a holy dip in the sacred river Ganges which is also called Bhagirathi at its origin. Perform Pooja and Darshan, after that relax for some time in the lovely surroundings. Return back to Uttarkashi. Overnight stay at Uttarkashi.
Gangotri Weather– The maximum temperature during summer can go up to 20° Celsius. Summer nights can get cooler with a minimum temperature of 10° Celsius. Light woolen clothes are required while visiting Gangotri during summer. The Winter season is very chilly in Gangotri. Gangotri will be covered in sheets of snow during winter. Pilgrim centers remain closed throughout winter due to heavy snow falls.
Distance – 100 KM
Time – 3-4 Hours

itinerary.title: DAY 05 Uttarkashi to Guptkashi (220kms/8-9hr) HT : 1319 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Morning after breakfast, drive to Guptkashi via Moolgarh & Lambgoan. En route, you can see the beautiful river Mandakini at Tilwara. The Mandakini river comes from Kedarnath, drive alongside the river to reach Guptakashi, visit Ardh Narishwar Temple in Guptakashi. Check into the hotel arrival in Guptakashi. Overnight stay at Guptakashi.
Guptakashi: The name Gupt Kashi means “Hidden Benares. Mythology describes how when the Pandava brothers were searching for a glimpse of Shiva, Shivji first concealed himself at Guptkashi, but later fled from them further up the valley to Kedarnath, where the Pandavas finally got their wish fulfilled. There are more tangible connections as well-the Kedarnath pandas (priests) live in Guptkashi during the winter months, and after the Kedarnath temple closes for the winter, the image of Kedarnath passes through Gupt Kashi on its way to Ukhimath (across the valley), where it stays for the winter.
Guptkashi Weather: pleasant in summer, the temperature ranges from 25-30 degree Celsius. Cold in winters.
Distance – 220 KM
Time – 8-9 Hours

itinerary.title: DAY 06 Guptkashi to Kedarnath to Guptkashi (30kms by road & 19kms Trek one way)
itinerary.text:
By Helicopter: Morning our driver will transfer you your prebook Helipad. After Back our car will drop you at Hotel for rest. (note: helicopter ticket is not included in this package)
By Helicopter: Morning our driver will transfer you your prebook Helipad. You can inform the driver about your arrival time whether it will by helicopter or by trek, so that Driver will be there to pick you up. (note: helicopter ticket is not included in this package).
By Trek: Morning our driver will drop you at Sonprayag then you have to take local jeep for Gaurikund & then your trek strat for Kedarnath Ji. After darshan, you follow the same & back to Sonpraag. There is big parking issue so the driver will back tp another palace if his contact no. is not working then you have to arrange another taxi or wait for your driver.
Overnight stay at Guptkashi.
Distance – 30 KM By Road & 19 KMs Trek (one way)

itinerary.title: DAY 07 Guptkashi to Badrinath (215kms/7hr) HT : 3133 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Morning after breakfast, drive to Badrinath. Check in to the hotel arrival in Badrinath. Pilgrims after having a bath in the Taptkund have the Darshan of Badrivishal & Aarti in the evening. Brahamakapal is significant for Pinddan Shraddh of ancestors (Pitrus). There is another interesting sightseeing spot like Mana, Vyas Gufa, Maatamoorti, Charanpaduka, Bhimkund, and the “Mukh” of the Saraswati River. Just within the three km of Badrinathjee. Overnight stay at Badrinath.
Mana Village : Inhabited by an Indo-Mongolian tribe, it is the last Indian village before Tibet.
Vasundhara : As the name suggests, Vasundhara is a magnificent waterfall. This place is 5km. from Badrinath out of which 2km. is motorable upto Mana.
Bhim Pul : On the other side of Mana village, a massive rock forming a natural bridge, lies over the roaring Saraswati river. It presents a spectacular view of water thundering down through the narrow passage under the rock and is believed to have been placed there by Bhim, the second eldest among the five Pandava brothers.
Vyas Gufa (cave) : Near Mana Village, this is a rock-cave where Ved Vyas is believed to have composed the Mahabharata and the pauranic commentaries.
Badrinath Weather: The average maximum temperature will be around 18° Celsius and the average minimum is 8° Celsius. Warm and woolen clothes are hence required for a stay in Badrinath throughout the year. Winter in Badrinath is often accompanied by snowfalls. Winter is very chilly with an average temperature of 5° Celsius. Due to the extreme climatic conditions, this time is usually closed for tourists.
Distance – 215 KM 7 Hours

itinerary.title: DAY 08 Badrinath to Rudraprayag (160kms) / Kirtinagar (200kms)
itinerary.text: Early morning, pilgrims after having a bath in the Taptkund have the Darshan of Badrivishal. Brahamakapal is significant for Pinddan Shraddh of ancestors (Pitrus). There is another interesting sightseeing spot like Mana, Vyas Gufa, Maatamoorti, Charanpaduka, Bhimkund, and the “Mukh” of the Saraswati River. Just within the three km of Badrinathjee. Later drive back to Rudraprayag / Kirtinagar via Joshimath. Check-in Hotel. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: DAY 09 Rudraprayag to Rishikesh to Haridwar (160kms/5hr)/Kirtinagar to Rishikesh to Haridwar (135kms/4hr)
itinerary.text:
Drive to Rishikesh, the ‘place of sages’ is a celebrated spiritual town on the bank of Ganga and is surrounded by the Shivalik range of the Himalayas on three sides. It is said that when Raibhya Rishi did hard penances, God appeared by the name of ” Hrishikesh ” and this area hence firth came to be known as Rishikesh.Later transfer to Haridwar Railway Station / Dehradun Airport. Tour Terminate.
Distance – 160 KM Time – 5 Hours

title: Corbett with Nainital
name: Corbett with Nainital
page_title: Corbett with Nainital 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Explore the wilderness of Corbett National Park and the beauty of Nainital with our 4-day tour package. Enjoy jungle safari, scenic views of Nainital, and a relaxing getaway in the Himalayas.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Corbett)Delhi to Corbett( 290 Kms - 8 Hours)
itinerary.text: Arrive Delhi. Pick up and transfer by surface to Corbett. The park was named after Jim Corbett, the legendary hunter-naturalist turned author and photographer who spent most years of his life in this area and helped set up this park. On Arrival transfer to Hotel and check in. Evening free for sightseeing covering Garjia temple and Corbett fall. Dinner and overnight stay in Corbett.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Nainital)Corbett to Nainital
itinerary.text:
After breakfast depart for Nainital by road. On arrival, check in to the hotel. Proceed for sightseeing tour, beginning with boating on the famous Nainital Lake-Naini Lake (at your own cost) and visit to the holy Naina Devi Temple. After that, visit famous tourist spots like Tiffin Top, Naina Peak, Cave Garden, Bara Pathar, Lover's Point, Lands End, Naina Peak etc.(sightseeing will be covered as per time permitting). In the evening, enjoy shopping at the Mall Road. Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel.
Note :-Tempo traveller or higher seating vehicle are allowed upto Nainital Parking only. For local sightseeing in Nainital guest has to take local vehicle for sightseeing from Nainital Union on direct payment basis
Distance between Corbett to Nainital is 90 Kms & 2.5 Hours drive approx.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Nainital)Nainital Lake Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast drive for lake tour of Nainital. Nainital is the main tourist attraction. Here Naini Lake is famous for boating (Half an hour ride), Bhimtal is about 25 kilometers from Nainital. It is the largest lake amoung Nainital Lake Tour, Sattal(seven lakes) is about 25 kilometers from Nainital. As name suggests is a group of seven lakes interconnected, Naukuchiatal is about 30 kilometers from Nainital. It is 9 cornered lake. Drive back to Hotel, Dinner & Overnight stay at Hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Nainital)Nainital to Delhi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Nainital and drive back to Delhi (about 320 km, 9 hours) through the Kumaon foothills and the plains. On arrival in Delhi, our driver drops you at the airport or railway station in time for your onward journey. The tour ends here, with memories of Corbett's forests and Nainital's lake.

name: Corbett With Nainital and mussoorie
page_title: Corbett With Nainital and mussoorie 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Explore the wilderness of Corbett National Park, the serenity of Nainital's lakes, and the scenic beauty of Mussoorie with our 7-day tour package.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Corbett)Delhi to Corbett( 290 Kms - 8 Hours)
itinerary.text: Our driver meets you in Delhi for the drive to Jim Corbett National Park (about 290 km, 8 hours), India's oldest national park and home of the Bengal tiger. After checking in at your resort near the park, relax for the rest of the day; safari permits for the next day can be arranged at extra cost. Evening at leisure. Overnight stay in Corbett.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Corbett)Corbett Park to Jeep Safari
itinerary.text:
Early morning enjoy jungle safari at the Corbett National Park (at your own cost). Return to the resort for breakfast. In the afternoon, visit Corbett Wildlife Museum, Dhikala which offers an awesome uninterrupted panoramic view of the valley. Back to the resort. Dinner and overnight at the hotel.
Corbett Tiger Reserve: India's first national park, cradled in the foothills of the Himalayas at 3300 feet asl, spreads over an area of 520 sq km. The magnificent Ramganga River flows through the entire length of the Park. Corbett has the highest density of tiger in India. Other carnivores include the leopard, elephant, bear, deer. Basking along the banks of the Ramganga are the slender snouted gharial and the marsh crocodile. There are watch towers, elephant safaris and jeep safaris for wildlife viewing.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Nainital)Corbett to Nainital
itinerary.text:
After breakfast depart for Nainital by road. On arrival, check in to the hotel. Proceed for sightseeing tour, beginning with boating on the famous Nainital Lake-Naini Lake (at your own cost) and visit to the holy Naina Devi Temple. After that, visit famous tourist spots like Tiffin Top, Naina Peak, Cave Garden, Bara Pathar, Lover's Point, Lands End, Naina Peak etc.(sightseeing will be covered as per time permitting). In the evening, enjoy shopping at the Mall Road. Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel.
Note:- Tempo traveller or higher seating vehicle are allowed upto Nainital Parking only. For local sightseeing in Nainital guest has to take local vehicle for sightseeing from Nainital Union on direct payment basis
Distance between Corbett to Nainital is 90 Kms & 2.5 Hours drive approx

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Nainital)Nainital Lake Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast drive for lake tour of Nainital. Nainital is the main tourist attraction. Here Naini Lake is famous for boating (Half an hour ride), Bhimtal is about 25 kilometers from Nainital. It is the largest lake amoung Nainital Lake Tour, Sattal(seven lakes) is about 25 kilometers from Nainital. As name suggests is a group of seven lakes interconnected, Naukuchiatal is about 30 kilometers from Nainital. It is 9 cornered lake. Drive back to Hotel, Dinner & Overnight stay at Hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Mussoorie)Nainital to Mussoorie( 340 Kms - 11 Hours)
itinerary.text:
After breakfast check out from hotel, drive to Mussoorie. Late evening arrive in Mussoorie & check in at your hotel. Evening at leisure. Overnight at the hotel.
Corbett Tiger Reserve:- India's first national park, cradled in the foothills of the Himalayas at 3300 feet asl, spreads over an area of 520 sq km. The magnificent Ramganga River flows through the entire length of the Park. Corbett has the highest density of tiger in India. Other carnivores include the leopard, elephant, bear, deer. Basking along the banks of the Ramganga are the slender snouted gharial and the marsh crocodile. There are watch towers, elephant safaris and jeep safaris for wildlife viewing.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Mussoorie)Mussoorie Local Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast proceed to visit famous Kemtey fall is 15Kms approx. from Mussoorie. It is popular tourists point in Mussoorie. Cloud Ends is 7Kms approx. from Mussoorie. It is hightest point of Mussorie offering awesome view to tourists. Camels Back Road is around 3Kms from Mussoorie. As name suggests rocks are shaped like a hump of camel at the end of road. Gun Hill Point is second highest point in Mussoorie. It is also accessible by a cable car. It offers complete view of Mussoorie. Lal Tibba (Red Hills) is located 6Kms from Mussoorie. If is famous among tourists to view sunset and sunrise.Also visit mall road. Back to the hotel. Overnight at Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Day 7 :(Mussoorie)Mussoorie to Delhi ( 310 Kms - 9 Hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Mussoorie and drive down via Dehradun to Delhi (about 310 km, 9 hours). On arrival in Delhi, our driver drops you at the airport or railway station for your onward journey. The tour ends here, with memories of the forests of Corbett, the lake at Nainital and the hills of Mussoorie.

title: Darjeeling and Gangtok Tour
name: Darjeeling and Gangtok Tour
page_title: Darjeeling and Gangtok Tour 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Discover the beauty of Darjeeling and Gangtok with our 6-day tour package. Explore the stunning Himalayan landscapes, tea gardens, and cultural landmarks of these iconic destinations.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Darjeeling)Arrival and Transfer to Darjeeling
itinerary.text: Our representative will be there to receive the Guest at New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) / Tenzing Norgay Bus Stand (Junction) – He will be assisting for the transfer - Darjeeling - Nearly 105 kilometers 3 ½ - 4 hours drive – At an height of 2123 meters / 70001 feet lies the land of breathtaking beauty, sloping tea gardens with spectacular views of the Mount Everest is the Queen of the hills – It is also home to the famous World Heritage train – The Darjeeling Himalayan Railway (DHR) - Check into hotel – Evening free to roam around Mall or local Shopping center - Over Night stay at Darjeeling

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Darjeeling)Darjeeling Local Sight Seeing (Half Day)
itinerary.text: Early morning at around 3:45 AM drive to 8000 feet / 2440 meters through primitive forests of oak, magnolia to Tiger Hill to view sunrise over Kanchendzonga Peak (subject to clear weather) – On the way back visit Ghoom Monastery, Peace memorial & Batasia Loop – Back to hotel for break fast - After breakfast next round of sight seeing - Half Day city tour includes Padmaja Naidu Zoological Park, Himalayan Mountaineering Institute (Closed on Thursday), Ropeway, Tensing Gumpo Rock, Tibetan Refugee Self Help Center (Closed on Sunday), Tea Estate, Natural History Museum (Sunday Closed), Peace Pagoda – Back to hotel – Evening free to stroll around the Mall area or Chowk Bazaar - Overnight stay at Darjeeling

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Gangtok)Darjeeling to Gangtok Transfer
itinerary.text: Early Morning Breakfast – Drive to Gangtok nearly 135 Kilometers 3 – 3 ½ hours - Gangtok – The capital of the 22 nd State of India, Sikkim is one of the most beautiful hill station with varied options for tourist – Gangtok the beautiful city of Sikkim suits all tourist due to its options i.e. tranquility to adventure, land of monastery, mystic rituals & festivals at an height of 1670 meters / 5480 feet and is the most visited spot of India - It is one of the most beautiful towns with varieties of Rhododendron, Orchids and butterflies – The road is along the River Teesta and is picturesque – Check into hotel at Gangtok – Evening free to roam around M G Road (Mall) or local Shopping center - Over Night stay at Gangtok

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Gangtok)Gangtok Local Sight Seeing (Full Day)
itinerary.text: Morning breakfast - After breakfast drive for the city tour of Gangtok – Sight seeing will be for half day hence the drive will be easy and comfortable – It is not possible to cover all the spot in single day hence we make the program with points covering minimum distance traveled - Visit to Directorate of Handicrafts & Handloom, Research Institute of Tibetology, Do Drul Chorten (Stupa), Enchey Monastery, White Hall, Flower Show, Rumtek Monastery – The monastery where Nobel Laurete Dalai Lama took shelter while escaping from China, Botanical Garden Ganesh Tok, Hanuman Tok, Tashi View Point, Banjhakri Falls, one of the finest falls close to Gangtok, etc – Back to hotel – Evening free to roam around M G Road (Mall) or local Shopping center – There are few discotheques in Gangtok to spend time - Over Night stay at Gangtok

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Gangtok)Excursion to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir (Full Day)
itinerary.text: Morning breakfast at hotel – Excursion to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir nearly 40 kilometers and 2 hours drive along the Kyongnosla Alpine Sanctuary, the home to the red panda and the blood pheasant with Rhododendron and other alpine trees along the road - Situated at an elevation of 3753 meters / 12310 feet - The Lake is oval shaped lake nearly 50 feet deep - Generally covered in snow for most of the year the year – This lake is home to the Brahmini ducks & many migratory birds – Nearby is the sacred Baba Mandir known to be a very holy site for all - Nathu La Pass to Republic of China is nearly 20 kilometers and is optional tour - Back to Gangtok - Evening free to roam around M G Road (Mall) or local Shopping center - Over Night stay at Gangtok

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Gangtok)Departure – Gangtok to Siliguri – Siliguri / New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) / Tenzing Norgay Bus Stand (Junction)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Gangtok. Our driver takes you down to Siliguri (about 135 km, 4½–5 hours), with the drop at New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP), Bagdogra Airport (IXB) or the Tenzing Norgay Bus Stand, as you need. It is best to start early so there is no rush on the mountain roads. Enjoy the last views of the hills and tea gardens on the way down. The tour ends at your drop point.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Gangtok)Excursion to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir (Full Day)

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Lachung)Sight Seeing at Yumthang

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Gangtok)Transfer to Gangtok

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Pelling)Gangtok Sight Seeing (Half Day) & Transfer to Pelling
itinerary.text: After breakfast at hotel - Depart for Half day city tour of Gangtok - Directorate of Handicrafts and Handlooms, Research Institute of Tibetology, Chorten (Stupa), Flower Show - Drive 125 kilometers, 3 – 3 ½ hours drive - Pelling is situated at an altitude of 2072 meters / 6800 feet - It is one of the exotic settlement with varieties of Rhododendron, Orchids, historical sites, short trek routes and wildlife – Its botanical and zoological richness is inspiring and the scenic view from the top of the ridge across deep valley to the heights of Kanchendzonga ranges is something to be seen to be believed - Yuksom, Ravangla, Rinchenpong and Namchi are some of the tourist spot nearby – Check into hotel - Evening free to roam around the small settlement - Over Night stay at Pelling

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Pelling)Pelling Local sightseeing (Full Day)
itinerary.text: After breakfast at hotel – Drive for Full Day Sight Seeing. The routes are forested and the botanical and zoological richness is inspiring. Places of visit are Rimbi water Falls, Rimbi Rock Garden, Kechopalri Lake, it is one of the holy Buddhist lake and it is believed that any wish in front of the lake comes true - Myth is that when a leaf falls on the placid clear water surface, it is picked by a bird and thus the water surface is always free of leaves, Kechopalri Monastery, Kanchenjunga water Falls, Pemayangtse Monastery, Rabdantse ruins, the scenic view from the top of the ruin to the mystic heights of Kanchendzonga ranges is something to be cherished – Back to hotel – Evening free to roam around the helipad or Shopping center - Over Night stay at Pelling

itinerary.text: A drive of 120 kilometers 3 ½ - 4 hours through scenic road via Jorethang and along the River Teesta for a short stretch – Darjeeling - It is situated at an height of 2123 meters / 70001 feet - It is a land of breathtaking beauty, sloping tea gardens with spectacular views of the Mount Everest is the Queen of the hills – Darjeeling is home to many international Schools and few of the internationally famous site like Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Padmaja Naidu Zoological Park, Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, etc – It is also home to the famous World Heritage train – The Darjeeling Himalayan Railway (DHR) - Check into hotel – Evening free - Over Night stay at Darjeeling

itinerary.title: Day 10 : (Darjeeling)Darjeeling to Siliguri via Kalimpong – departure
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Darjeeling and drive to Kalimpong (about 50 km, 2 hours). Then continue down to Siliguri (about 70 km, 2½–3 hours) for your drop at New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP), Bagdogra Airport (IXB) or the Tenzing Norgay Bus Stand. The tour ends here.

title: Darjeeling with Pelling and Gangtok Tour
name: Darjeeling with Pelling and Gangtok Tour
page_title: Darjeeling with Pelling and Gangtok Tour 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Discover the charm of Darjeeling, Pelling, and Gangtok with our 6-day tour package. Experience the majestic Himalayas, stunning landscapes, and rich cultural heritage on this scenic journey.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Darjeeling)Arrival and Transfer to Darjeeling
itinerary.text: Our representative will be present to receive the Guest at New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) / Tenzing Norgay Bus Stand (Junction) – He will be assisting you to reach Darjeeling - Nearly 85 kilometers 3 ½ - 4 hours drive –Darjeeling(2123 meters / 7001 feet) is located in northern part of West Bengal –Surrounded by Himalayan mountain ridges, pleasant climate and beautiful tea gardens- Darjeeling is a paradise for trekkers and adventure lovers-It is the home of famous Toy Train, Himalayan Mountaineering Institute(established by Tenzing Norgay),Tiger Hill, Ghoom Gompa and Peace Memorial–Places to visit nearby are Mirik,Kurseong, Kalimpong ,Pashupati market and Phalut- Check-in to the hotel – Evening free to stroll around the around Mall, Chowrasta or the Local market area - OverNight stay at Darjeeling

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Darjeeling)Darjeeling Local Sight Seeing
itinerary.text: Morning drive from your hotel to Tiger Hill (8482 feet / 2590 meters) at around 3:45 am-Catch the stunning sight of early rays of sun falling over Mount Kanchenjunga(if the weather is clear)– Please note Tiger Hill excursion is available only in early morning after which it is closed -While returning back, a visit to Ghoom Monastery, Peace memorial & Batasia -Back to hotel for breakfast - After breakfast rest for half an hour -Then next round of sightseeing - Full Day city tour of places Padmaja Naidu Zoological Park, Himalayan Mountaineering Institute (Closed on Thursday), Ropeway, , Tibetan Refugee Self Help Center (Closed on Sunday),Beautiful Tea Estate, Natural History Museum (Sunday Closed), Peace Pagoda -The car will be at your disposal-But it might be impossible to cover all the sites mentioned above in a single day – Back to hotel – Evening free to stroll around the area - OverNight stay at Darjeeling

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Pelling)Transfer to Pelling and Local Sightseeing in Pelling
itinerary.text: Early breakfast and then drive to your next destination Pelling-Pelling is 75 kilometres and 4-5 hours drive from Darjeeling-Pelling (2072 meters / 6800 feet) is situated in Sikkim-It is a popular hill station of West Sikkim-Pelling is popular for its spectacular view of Himalayan mountain ridges like Koktang,Frey,Rathong,Kabru North ,Kabru South, Kabru Dom,Talung,Pandim,Jupuno,Narsing and Tinchikhang ( only if the weather is clear),rich alpine forests, mystic waterfalls, soft treks routes and tranquility-Pelling is also an ideal spot for adventure sports-Foreigners need to obtain Inner Line Permit before entering Sikkim-Please carry any kind of photo identity proof and passport size photos--Avoid plucking orchids and catching butterflies as it leads to judicial proceedings in Sikkim--Check into Hotel-After Lunch sightseeing to places like are Rimbi water Falls, Rimbi Rock Garden, Khecheopalri Lake, a wish fulfilling sacred lake - Myth is that the birds do not allow a single leaf to fall on the surface of the lake- It is interesting to note that the shape of the lake is like a human footprint - Kanchenjunga water Falls, Changey Waterfalls,Sangachoeling monastery,Singhshore Bridge, Pemayangtse Monastery, Rabdantse ruins, the scenic view from the top of the ruin to the mystic heights of Kanchenjunga ranges is something to be cherished –The places to be covered will depend on the time left-Driving at night is not advised-Overnight stay in Pelling.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Gangtok)Transfer to Gangtok and Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text: Early Breakfast and then transfer to Gangtok-Gangtok is 135 kilometres and 5-6 hours drive from Pelling-Gangtok(5800 feet/1800m) is the capital of Sikkim-Located in East Sikkim-It is the most visited tourist destination-Gangtok is famous for its monasteries, picturesque site of Himalayas, stunning landcape,rich variety of fauna and flora(basically orchids and butterflies) and steaming dumplings- -Smoking or selling any form of tobacco is strictly banned here-Check into the hotel-After Lunch visit to Directorate of Handicrafts & Handloom, Research Institute of Tibetology, Do Drul Chorten (Stupa), Enchey Monastery, White Hall, Flower Show, Rumtek Monastery, Kabi Lungchok,Fambong La Wildlife Sanctuary, Rumtek Monastery – The monastery where Nobel Laurete Dalai Lama took shelter while escaping from China-Other places to visit are Botanical Garden Ganesh Tok, Hanuman Tok, Tashi View Point, Banjhakri Falls, one of the finest falls close to Gangtok, etc - The car will be at your disposal – Back to hotel – Evening free to roam around M G Road (Mall) or local Shopping center – There are few discotheques in Gangtok to spend time - Over Night stay at Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Gangtok)Excursion to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir (Full Day)
itinerary.text: Early breakfast at hotel – Our full day excursion to Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir which is 40 km from Gangtok at the altitude of 3753 meters/ 12310 feet- Generally covered in snow for most of the year –It is an oval-shaped lake which is 15m deep and almost 1km long-You won’t be disappointed with this visit as the combination of landscape and lake is a view not to be forgotten even after you leave the place-It’s just amazing – This lake is home to the Brahmini ducks & many migratory birds – Nearby is the sacred Baba Mandir built in remembrance of Baba Harbhajan Singh who went missing from this place - Nathu La Pass to Republic of China is nearly 20 kilometers and is an optional tour –Photo identity card and passport size photo is required for visiting Tsomgo Lake and Nathu La-A special permit is required in advance to visit Nathu La-Foreigners are not allowed in Nathu La Pass- Back to Gangtok -In evening free to roam around M G Road (Mall) or local Shopping center - Driving in hills after sunset is not advised -Over Night stay at Gangtok

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Gangtok)Departure – Gangtok to Siliguri
