title: Discover Leh Ladakh Tour
name: Discover Leh Ladakh Tour
page_title: Discover Leh Ladakh Tour 8 Nights / 9 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Embark on an unforgettable 9-day adventure with our Discover Leh Ladakh tour. Experience the rugged beauty, high-altitude landscapes, and rich culture of Leh Ladakh in this comprehensive 8-night journey.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Leh)Leh Arrival
itinerary.text: Arrive at Leh's Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport, where our representative meets you and transfers you to your hotel. Leh is at about 3,500 m, so the rest of the day is for rest and acclimatisation, with welcome tea or coffee at the hotel. In the evening, if you feel well, visit the Shanti Stupa for sunset views over Leh, then stroll through the market. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Leh)Leh-Excursion to Sham Valley-Leh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, you drive downstream along the River Indus on Leh – Kargil Highway. And start our sightseeing with Hall of Fame (Museum Constructed by India Army) near Leh is worth a visit for every Indian, and proceed further to Gurudwara Patthar Sahib Nestled deep in the Himalayas, A drive of another 4 km took us to Magnetic Hill which defies the law of gravity & further Driving through a picturesque landscape we reached the Confluence Of The Indus And Zanskar River. After visiting above places we drive back to Leh enroute visiting Spituk Monastery, Built in the 15th century during the reign of Grags ‘bum-lde, this new Gelug-pa monastery was built like a fortress on the summit of crags. Evening at leisure and Overnight at Hotel in Leh

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Nubra Valley)Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La (120 km / 5–6 hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive from Leh to Nubra Valley (about 120 km, 5–6 hours) over the Khardung La pass, one of the highest motorable passes in the world. Descend into the valley of the Shyok and Nubra rivers, with sand dunes, apricot orchards and small villages. In the afternoon, visit the dunes at Hunder, where you can ride a double-humped Bactrian camel at your own cost. Overnight stay in a camp or hotel in Nubra.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Leh)Nubra Valley to Leh (120 km / 4–5 hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Diskit Monastery, the oldest in Nubra, with its large Maitreya Buddha statue overlooking the valley. Then drive back to Leh (about 120 km, 4–5 hours) over Khardung La. On arrival, check in at your hotel and spend the evening at leisure in Leh market. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Pangong)Leh-Pangong Lake (140 KMS / 4 - 5 HRS )
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, we leave for Pangong Lake, we drive towards Changla Pass 5486 Mtrs. The long easy ascent takes you to Changla pass through its winding roads passing through Sakti Village. Stop at the Changla Pass for a quick photograph session and drive down to the village of Tangtse, where you can relax for a cup of tea. Leaving Tangtse for Pangong you pass through few small villages of Changthang and finally, you can have a sudden view of the Pangong Lake situated at 14,000 feet (4,267 m). This famous blue brackish Lake of Pangong is 5/6 Kms wide and over 133 Kms long with half of its running the other side of the "Indo China Border". One rarely feels so close to nature and environment and the scenery is unforgettable. Upon arrival, we check in at our Camp Near Pangong lake. Dinner & Overnight at the Camp.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Leh)Pangong Lake-Leh (140 KMS / 6 HRS)
itinerary.text: Wake early to see the colours of Pangong Lake change with the morning light. After breakfast, drive back to Leh (about 140 km, 6 hours) over the Chang La pass. On the way you can stop at Thiksey or Shey if you did not visit them earlier. Check in at your hotel in Leh and rest in the evening. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Tso Moriri)Leh to Tso Moriri
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, leave Leh for Tso Moriri (about 220 km, 7–8 hours), following the Indus river and passing the village of Chumathang, known for its hot springs. The road then climbs into the Changthang plateau, home to nomadic herders and wildlife such as wild asses and marmots. Tso Moriri is a high-altitude lake ringed by mountains, with the small village and monastery of Korzok on its shore. Overnight stay at Tso Moriri.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Leh)Tsomorir-Tsokar-Tanglangla-Leh (240 KMS / 8 HRS)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, leave Tso Moriri and drive back to Leh (about 240 km, 8 hours) by a different route, past the salt lake of Tso Kar, a good spot for birds such as black-necked cranes in season, and over the Tanglang La pass, one of the highest motorable passes in the region. Descend through the Indus valley to Leh and check in at your hotel. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 9 : (Leh)Departure from Leh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel. Depending on your flight time, you may have a little time for last-minute shopping in Leh market. Our representative then drops you at Leh airport for your onward flight; the departure transfer is included. The Discover Leh Ladakh tour ends here.

title: Do Dham Yatra (Kedarnath - Badrinath) Tour from Haridwar 5 Days Package
name: Do Dham Yatra
page_title: Do Dham Yatra (Kedarnath - Badrinath) Tour from Haridwar | Divine Pilgrimage
description: Embark on a soul-stirring Do Dham Yatra from Haridwar to Kedarnath and Badrinath. Explore the sacred shrines nestled in the Himalayas, experience divine serenity, and immerse yourself in spiritual bliss. Book your hassle-free pilgrimage tour now!

itinerary.title: DAY 01 Haridwar to Guptkashi (220kms/8-9hr) Height: 1319 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Meet our driver at Haridwar morning and drive to Guptkashi via Rudraprayag & Devprayag. En route you can see the beautiful river Ganga and Alaknanda River till Rudraprayag. The Mandakini river comes from Kedarnath, drive alongside the river to reach Guptakashi, visit Ardh Narishwar (Vishwanath) Temple in Guptakashi. Check into the hotel arrival in Guptakashi. Overnight stay at Guptakashi.
Guptakashi - The name Gupt Kashi means “Hidden Benares. Mythology describes how when the Pandava brothers were searching for a glimpse of Shiva, Shivji first concealed himself at Guptkashi, but later fled from them further up the valley to Kedarnath, where the Pandavas finally got their wish fulfilled. There are more tangible connections as well-the Kedarnath pandas (priests) live in Guptkashi during the winter months, and after the Kedarnath temple closes for the winter, the image of Kedarnath passes through Gupt Kashi on its way to Ukhimath (across the valley), where it stays for the winter.
Guptkashi Weather – Pleasant in summer, the temperature ranges from 25-30 degree Celsius. Cold in winters.
Distance – 210 KM
Time – 8-9 Hours

itinerary.title: DAY 02 Guptkashi to Kedarnath to Guptkashi (30kms by road & 19kms Trek one way) Height: 3384 MTS.
itinerary.text:
By Helicopter: Morning our driver will transfer you to your prebooked Helipad. After Back our car will drop you at Hotel for rest. (note: helicopter ticket is not included in this package).
By Trek : Though it is difficult to go up and down from Sonprayag on the same day by trek. But it can be done if you take ponies or a helicopter while going to Kedarnath. Do coordinate well with the driver, as due to parking issue driver cannot stay at Sonprayag also network issue is also there.
Kedarnath: The Kedarnath shrine, one of the 12 jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva, is a scenic spot situated, against the backdrop of the majestic Kedarnath range. Kedar is another name of Lord Shiva. According to legend, the Pandavas after having won over the Kaurava in the Kurukshetra war felt guilty of having killed their own brothers and sought the blessings of Lord Shiva for redemption. He eluded them repeatedly and while fleeing took refuge at Kedarnath in the form of a bull. On being followed he dived into the ground, leaving his hump on the surface. The remaining portions of Lord Shiva appeared at four other places and are worshipped there as his manifestations. The arms appeared at Tungnath, the face at Rudranath, the belly at Madhmaheshwar, and his locks (hair) with the head at Kalpeshwar. Kedarnath and the four above-mentioned shrines are treated as Panch Kedar.
Kedarnath Weather – Due to its high altitude the weather in Kedarnath remains cold for the most part of the year. Summer here is cool and pleasant while winter is severe. During the summer season, the temperature varies around 20°Celsius. Light woolen wear is recommended. The Winter season in Kedarnath is severe with the mercury falling to as low as 0°Celsius. During this time the place experiences snowfall as well. Due to the extreme climatic conditions, this time is usually avoided by tourists.
Distance – 30kms by road & 19kms Trek one way

itinerary.title: DAY 03 Guptkashi to Badrinath (160kms/7hr) Height: 3133 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Morning after breakfast, drive to Badrinath. Check in to the hotel arrival in Badrinath. Pilgrims after having a bath in the Taptkund have the Darshan of Badrivishal & Aarti in the evening. Brahamakapal is significant for Pinddan Shraddh of ancestors (Pitrus). There is another interesting sightseeing spot like Mana, Vyas Gufa, Maatamoorti, Charanpaduka, Bhimkund, and the “Mukh” of the Saraswati River. Just within the three km of Badrinathjee. Overnight stay at Badrinath. Badrinath one of the ‘Ancient Four Dhams’ is one of the most celebrated pilgrimage spots of the country and is situated at an elevation of 3,133 meters, guarded on either side by the two mountain ranges known as Nar & Narayan with the towering Neelkanth Peak providing a splendid backdrop. This revered spot was once carpeted with wild berries. Thus the place got the name “Badri van”, meaning “forest of berries”.
Tapt Kund: Natural thermal springs on the bank of the river Alaknanda, where it is customary to bathe before entering the Badrinath temple.
Mana Village: Inhabited by an Indo-Mongolian tribe, it is the last Indian village before Tibet.
Vasundhara : As the name suggests, Vasundhara is a magnificent waterfall. This place is 5 km. from Badrinath out of which 2 km. is motorable upto Mana.
Badrinath Weather: The average maximum temperature will be around 18° Celsius and the average minimum is 8° Celsius. Warm and woolen clothes are hence required for a stay in Badrinath throughout the year. Winter in Badrinath is often accompanied by snowfalls. Winter is very chilly with an average temperature of 5° Celsius. Due to the extreme climatic conditions, this time is usually closed for tourists.
Distance – 160 KM
Time – 7 Hours

itinerary.title: DAY 04 Badrinath to Joshimath to Rudraprayag (160kms/7hr) Height: 895 MTS.
itinerary.text:
The morning after breakfast, a driver for Rudraprayag via Joshimath. Visit on the way Narsingh Temple in Joshimath later drive back to Rudraprayag via Joshimath. Check into the hotel arrival in Rudraprayag. Overnight stay at Rudraprayag.
Joshimath is situated on the slopes above the confluence of the rivers Alaknanda and Dhauliganga. Of the four ‘Maths’ established by Adi Shankaracharya, Joshimath is the winter seat of Badrinath. The idol is brought down to Joshimath and installed in the temple for people to worship. There are many other temples in the township. The most important is the temple of Nir Singh with the idol of Lord Vishnu. The left arm of this deity is getting destroyed with time and the popular belief holds that the day the arm completely withers Badrinath valley will cease to exist and the Gods will transfer the residence into the neighboring Niti Valley at Bhavishya Badri.
Rudraprayag Weather – Generally hot in summer, the temperature ranges from 35-40 degree Celsius, Winter: The Days are pleasantly cool but the nights are cold, temp ranges from 20 deg to 05 deg.
Distance – 160 KM
Time – 7 Hours

itinerary.title: DAY 05 Rudraprayag to Haridwar (165kms/5-6hr)
itinerary.text:
Morning after breakfast, drive for Haridwar via Rishikesh. Rishikesh ‘place of sages’ is a celebrated spiritual town on the bank of Ganga and is surrounded by the Shivalik range of the Himalayas on three sides. It is said that when Raibhya Rishi did hard penances, God appeared by the name of ” Hrishikesh ” and this area hence firth came to be known as Rishikesh. Check-in Hotel. Later visit Rishikesh Temples & Sight Seeing – Laxman Jhulla, Ram Jhulla. Drop at Haridwar.
Rishikesh: Named after the Lord Vishnu, Rishikesh is a holy city for Hindus. Located in the foothills of the Himalaya in northern India it is also known as the yoga center of the world and is home to many world-renowned ashrams. Rishikesh styles itself as the ‘Yoga Capital of the World’, with masses of ashrams and all kinds of yoga and meditation classes. The fast-flowing Ganges is surrounded by forested hills inside the city. Apart from temples and ashrams, Rishikesh is now a popular white-water rafting center, backpacker hang-out, and gateway to treks in the Himalaya.
Distance – 165 KM
Time – 5-6 Hours

title: 6-Day Do Dham Yatra (Kedarnath & Badrinath) Tour from Haridwar
name: Do Dham Yatra Tour Package
page_title: 6-Day Do Dham Yatra (Kedarnath & Badrinath) Tour from Haridwar | Spiritual Journey
description: Join a 6-day Do Dham Yatra from Haridwar to Kedarnath and Badrinath. Discover divine blessings at two sacred shrines, enjoy breathtaking Himalayan views, and experience a serene spiritual retreat. Book your 6-day pilgrimage package now!

itinerary.title: DAY 01 Haridwar to Guptkashi (220kms/8-9hr) Height: 1319 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Meet our driver at Haridwar morning and drive to Guptkashi via Rudraprayag & Devprayag. En route you can see the beautiful river Ganga and Alaknanda River till Rudraprayag. The Mandakini river comes from Kedarnath, drive alongside the river to reach Guptakashi, visit Ardh Narishwar (Vishwanath) Temple in Guptakashi. Check into the hotel arrival in Guptakashi. Overnight stay at Guptakashi.
Guptakashi - The name Gupt Kashi means “Hidden Benares. Mythology describes how when the Pandava brothers were searching for a glimpse of Shiva, Shivji first concealed himself at Guptkashi, but later fled from them further up the valley to Kedarnath, where the Pandavas finally got their wish fulfilled. There are more tangible connections as well-the Kedarnath pandas (priests) live in Guptkashi during the winter months, and after the Kedarnath temple closes for the winter, the image of Kedarnath passes through Gupt Kashi on its way to Ukhimath (across the valley), where it stays for the winter.
Guptkashi Weather– pleasant in summer, the temperature ranges from 25-30 degree Celsius. Cold in winters.
Distance – 210 KM
Time – 8-9 Hours

itinerary.title: DAY 02 Guptkashi to Kedarnath (30kms by road & 19kms Trek)
itinerary.text:
Morning after breakfast departure for Kedarnath dham. Enjoy Kedarnath Darshan & back your hotel. Overnight stay at Kedarnath.
By Helicopter: Morning our driver will transfer you your prebook Helipad. You can inform driver about your arrival time whether it will by helicopter or by trek, so that Driver will be there to pick you up. (note: helicopter ticket is not included in this package).
By Trek : Morning our driver will drop you at Sonprayag then you have to take local jeep for Gaurikund & then your trek strat for Kedarnath Ji. After darshan, you follow same & back to Sonpraag. There is big parking issue so the driver will back tp another palace if his contact no. in not working then you have to arrange another taxi or wait for your driver.
Kedarnath: The Kedarnath shrine, one of the 12 jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva, is a scenic spot situated, against the backdrop of the majestic Kedarnath range. Kedar is another name of Lord Shiva. According to legend, the Pandavas after having won over the Kaurava in the Kurukshetra war felt guilty of having killed their own brothers and sought the blessings of Lord Shiva for redemption. He eluded them repeatedly and while fleeing took refuge at Kedarnath in the form of a bull. On being followed he dived into the ground, leaving his hump on the surface.
Kedarnath Weather – Due to its high altitude the weather in Kedarnath remains cold for the most part of the year. Summer here is cool and pleasant while winter is severe. During the summer season the temperature varies around 20°Celsius. Light woolen wear is recommended. The Winter season in Kedarnath is severe with the mercury falling to as low as 0°Celsius. During this time the place experiences snowfall as well. Due to the extreme climatic conditions, this time is usually avoided by tourists.
Distance – 30kms by road & 19kms Trek one way

itinerary.title: DAY 03 Kedarnath to Guptkashi (19Kms Down Trek & 30kms/1hr by Road)
itinerary.text: After the morning puja and breakfast, check out of your hotel at Kedarnath and trek back down to Sonprayag (about 19 km); ponies and palkis are available at your own cost. Our driver meets you at the agreed place and drives you to your hotel in Guptkashi (about 30 km, 1 hour). Rest in the evening after the trek. Overnight stay in Guptkashi.

itinerary.title: DAY 04 Guptkashi to Badrinath (160kms/7hr) Height: 3133 MTS.
itinerary.text:
Morning after breakfast, drive to Badrinath. Check in to the hotel arrival in Badrinath. Pilgrims after having a bath in the Taptkund have the Darshan of Badrivishal & Aarti in the evening. Brahamakapal is significant for Pinddan Shraddh of ancestors (Pitrus). There is another interesting sightseeing spot like Mana, Vyas Gufa, Maatamoorti, Charanpaduka, Bhimkund, and the “Mukh” of the Saraswati River. Just within the three km of Badrinathjee. Overnight stay at Badrinath.
Badrinath one of the ‘Ancient Four Dhams’ is one of the most celebrated pilgrimage spots of the country and is situated at an elevation of 3,133 meters, guarded on either side by the two mountain ranges known as Nar & Narayan with the towering Neelkanth Peak providing a splendid backdrop. This revered spot was once carpeted with wild berries. Thus the place got the name “Badri van”, meaning “forest of berries”.
Tapt Kund: Natural thermal springs on the bank of the river Alaknanda, where it is customary to bathe before entering the Badrinath temple.
Mana Village: Inhabited by an Indo-Mongolian tribe, it is the last Indian village before Tibet.
Vasundhara: As the name suggests, Vasundhara is a magnificent waterfall. This place is 5 km. from Badrinath out of which 2 km. is motorable upto Mana.
Badrinath Weather: The average maximum temperature will be around 18° Celsius and the average minimum is 8° Celsius. Warm and woolen clothes are hence required for a stay in Badrinath throughout the year. Winter in Badrinath is often accompanied by snowfalls. Winter is very chilly with an average temperature of 5° Celsius. Due to the extreme climatic conditions, this time is usually closed for tourists.
Distance – 160 KM
Time – 7 Hours

itinerary.title: DAY 05 Badrinath to Joshimath to Rudraprayag (160kms/7hr) Height: 895 MTS.
itinerary.text:
The morning after breakfast, a driver for Rudraprayag via Joshimath. Visit on the way Narsingh Temple in Joshimath later drive back to Rudraprayag via Joshimath. Check into the hotel arrival in Rudraprayag. Overnight stay at Rudraprayag.
Joshimath is situated on the slopes above the confluence of the rivers Alaknanda and Dhauliganga. Of the four ‘Maths’ established by Adi Shankaracharya, Joshimath is the winter seat of Badrinath. The idol is brought down to Joshimath and installed in the temple for people to worship. There are many other temples in the township. The most important is the temple of Nir Singh with the idol of Lord Vishnu. The left arm of this deity is getting destroyed with time and the popular belief holds that the day the arm completely withers Badrinath valley will cease to exist and the Gods will transfer the residence into the neighboring Niti Valley at Bhavishya Badri.
Rudraprayag Weather Generally hot in summer, the temperature ranges from 35-40 degree Celsius, Winter: The Days are pleasantly cool but the nights are cold, temp ranges from 20 deg to 05 deg.
Distance – 160 KM
Time – 7 Hours

itinerary.title: DAY 06 Rudraprayag to Haridwar (165kms/5-6hr)
itinerary.text:
Morning after breakfast, drive for Haridwar via Rishikesh. Rishikesh ‘place of sages’ is a celebrated spiritual town on the bank of Ganga and is surrounded by the Shivalik range of the Himalayas on three sides. It is said that when Raibhya Rishi did hard penances, God appeared by the name of ” Hrishikesh ” and this area hence firth came to be known as Rishikesh. Check-in Hotel. Later visit Rishikesh Temples & Sight Seeing – Laxman Jhulla, Ram Jhulla. Drop at Haridwar.
Rishikesh: Named after the Lord Vishnu, Rishikesh is a holy city for Hindus. Located in the foothills of the Himalaya in northern India it is also known as the yoga center of the world and is home to many world-renowned ashrams. Rishikesh styles itself as the ‘Yoga Capital of the World’, with masses of ashrams and all kinds of yoga and meditation classes. The fast-flowing Ganges is surrounded by forested hills inside the city. Apart from temples and ashrams, Rishikesh is now a popular white-water rafting center, backpacker hang-out, and gateway to treks in the Himalaya.
Distance – 165 KM
Time – 5-6 Hours

title: Gangtok with Pelling and Kalimpong Tour
name: Gangtok with Pelling and Kalimpong Tour
page_title: Gangtok with Pelling and Kalimpong Tour 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Experience the charm of Sikkim with our 7-day tour package covering Gangtok, Pelling, and Kalimpong. Immerse yourself in breathtaking views, rich cultural heritage, and serene hill stations.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Gangtok)Arrival in Gangtok
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bagdogra airport or New Jalpaiguri railway station, where our driver meets you for the drive to Gangtok (about 125 km, 4–5 hours) along the Teesta river. After checking in at your hotel, the evening is free to explore MG Marg, Gangtok's car-free main street, lined with shops, cafés and restaurants. Gangtok sits on a ridge with views of the Kanchenjunga range on clear days. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Gangtok)Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir excursion
itinerary.text: Leave early for Tsomgo (Changu) Lake at about 12,400 ft, a glacial lake that is frozen in winter and surrounded by mountains. Continue to the Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir. A visit to Nathu La on the India–China border is optional and depends on permits; it is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays. Return to Gangtok in the afternoon; the evening is free. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Pelling)Gangtok to Pelling
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive to Pelling (about 5–6 hours) in West Sikkim. On the way you can stop at Namchi to see Siddhesvara Dham (Char Dham) and the giant statue of Guru Padmasambhava at Samdruptse hill. After checking in at your hotel in Pelling, the evening is free to explore the small local market or relax with views of Kanchenjunga. Overnight stay in Pelling.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Pelling)Pelling Sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, explore Pelling. Visit Pemayangtse Monastery, one of the oldest in Sikkim, and the Rabdentse ruins, the second capital of the old kingdom of Sikkim, with fine views of the valley. Then see the skywalk and Sangachoeling Monastery, the sacred Khecheopalri Lake in the forest, and the Rimbi and Kanchenjunga waterfalls. Return to your hotel for the overnight stay in Pelling.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Kalimpong)Pelling to Kalimpong
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive to Kalimpong (about 4–5 hours). After checking in at your hotel, begin your sightseeing with Deolo Hill, the highest point in Kalimpong, Dr. Graham's Homes, founded in 1900, the Mangal Dham temple and the Pine View Nursery, known for its cactus collection. The evening is free to rest. Overnight stay in Kalimpong.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Kalimpong)Kalimpong Local Sightseeing and Leisure
itinerary.text: After breakfast, continue exploring Kalimpong. Visit the Zang Dhok Palri Phodang monastery, which holds rare Tibetan scriptures, Durpin Dara hill with its views of the Teesta valley, and the Tharpa Choling monastery. The afternoon is free to explore the local markets, known for orchids and handicrafts, or simply relax in the quiet of the hills. Overnight stay in Kalimpong.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Kalimpong)Departure from Kalimpong
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Kalimpong. Our driver takes you down to Bagdogra airport or New Jalpaiguri railway station (about 3–4 hours) for your onward journey. Enjoy the last views of the Teesta river and the hills on the way. The tour ends here.

title: Jewels of Leh Ladakh Tour
name: Jewels of Leh Ladakh Tour
page_title: Jewels of Leh Ladakh Tour 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Discover the charm of Kashmir with our 5-day Jewels of Leh Ladakh tour package. Explore the valley's beauty, experience the thrill of adventure, and create unforgettable memories.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Leh)Arrive Leh - Leisure
itinerary.text: On your arrival at Leh airport, our representative will meet and transfer you to the Hotel. Check in to the hotel and the rest of the day is for leisure. A complete rest of the day is necessary for the rest of the day to accustom you and to the obscure air at the high altitude. Leh is situated at the height of 11563 feet. Evening visit Shanti Stupa. Later visit the market (stay for 01hour only). Return back to the hotel for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Leh)LEH – Excursion to Sham Valley Upto Sangam; Monastery Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast, you drive downstream along the River Indus on Leh – Kargil Highway. And start our sightseeing with Hall of Fame (Museum Constructed by India Army) near Leh is worth a visit for every Indian, and proceed further to GurudwaraPatthar Sahib Nestled deep in the Himalayas, A drive of another 4 km took us to Magnetic Hill which defies the law of gravity & further Driving through a picturesque landscape we reached the Confluence Of The Indus And Zanskar River. After visiting places we drive back to Leh en route visiting Spituk Monastery, Built-in 15th century during the reign of Grags ‘bum-lde, this new Gelug-pa monastery was built like the fortress on the summit of crags. Later proceed for Indus Valley Monastery Starting with Hemis Gompa, the largest monastic foundation of Drukpa Kagyu Order of Tibetan Buddhism, Thiksey Monastery an impressive complex rising tier upon tier on a hill above the village, Shey Palace, The ancient capital of Ladakh, 3 Idiots Rancho School & Sindhu Ghat. After visiting places we drive back to Leh. Evening at leisure to explore the city on your own. Return back to the hotel for Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Nubra Valley)Leh–Nubra Valley Via Khardung La 18,390 FT. (120 KMS / 5 – 6 HRS)
itinerary.text:
Post breakfast drives to Nubra Valley. The road journey from Leh to Nubra Valley passes over Khardung La (The Highest Motorable Road In The World) at 5,602 Mtrs / 18,390 Ft, around 39 km from Leh. From the pass, one can see all the way south over the Indus valley to seemingly endless peaks and ridges of the Zanskar range, and north to the giants of the Sasser massif. Nubra Valley is popularly known as Ldumra or the valley of flowers. It is situated in the north of Ladakh between the Karakoram and Ladakh ranges of the Himalayas. The average altitude of the valley is 10,000 Ft. above sea level.
Upon arrival in Nubra, we check in at our Camp / Hotel for Overnight stay. In the evening you can walk around the tiny villages to see how the locals live in this part of the world. A visit to a Ladakhi home can be arranged. Overnight Stay at the Camp or Hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Leh)Nubra Valley to Leh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Diskit Monastery, the oldest in Nubra, with its large Maitreya Buddha statue overlooking the valley. Then drive back to Leh (about 120 km, 4–5 hours) over Khardung La by the private vehicle included for transfers. On arrival, check in at your hotel and spend the evening at leisure in Leh market. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Leh)Pangong Lake excursion
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, set out on an excursion to Pangong Lake (about 140 km each way) over the Chang La pass. The lake, which stretches into Tibet, changes colour from blue to green with the light. Spend time by the shore for photographs before driving back to Leh in the evening. It is a long day, so carry warm clothes and water. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Leh)Departure from Leh
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, the time is free until your departure; check-out time is 12 noon. You can visit Leh market for last-minute shopping for pashmina, apricots or Tibetan handicrafts. You are then transferred to Leh airport for your onward flight; the departure transfer is included. With this, your Leh Ladakh tour ends.

itinerary.text: Our representative will be there to receive the Guest at New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) / Tenzing Norgay Bus Stand (Junction) - He will assist guest to proceed to Kalimpong - Nearly 85 Kilometers, 3 ½ - 4 Hours - Kalimpong is a historical destination on the old silk route - It is situated on the foothills of the Himalayas at an elevation of 1243 meters / 4078 feet - Kalimpong is a hill station buzzing with colorful people with lovely orchids, Gladiolus, rarest cacti and nurseries and offers spectacular views of the Mount Kanchendzonga and its range - It is ideal setting with milder climate for walks - Check into Hotel / resort – Evening free to roam around the local market or nursery - Over night stay at Kalimpong

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Gangtok)Sight Seeing in Kalimpong & Transfer to Gangtok
itinerary.text: Morning breakfast in hotel – Drive for sight seeing at Kalimpong - Drive for sight seeing tour through scenic road to Forest Museum (Closed On Thursday), Deolo Hill, Hanuman Mandir, Dr Graham Homes, Durbin Monastery, Mangaldham, Pine View Nurseries (Cactus Only) - Transfer to Gangtok – 130 Kilometers 3 – 3 ½ hours - Gangtok – The capital of the 22 nd State of India, Sikkim is one of the most beautiful hill station with varied options for tourist – It is known for the monastery, Orchids, High altitude Lake and butterflies – Gangtok is the hub of all tourist activities – Lachung, Lachen, Pelling, Namchi and other places of interest are all access able from here - Check into Hotel – Evening free to roam around M G Road or Lal Market - Over Night stay at Gangtok

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Gangtok)Excursion to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir (Full Day)
itinerary.text: Morning breakfast at hotel – Excursion to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir nearly 40 kilometers and 2 hours drive along the Kyongnosla Alpine Sanctuary, the home to the red panda and the blood pheasant with Rhododendron and other alpine trees along the road - Situated at an elevation of 3753 meters / 12310 feet - The Lake is oval shaped lake nearly 50 feet deep - Generally covered in snow for most of the year the year – This lake is home to the Brahmini ducks & many migratory birds – Nearby is the sacred Baba Mandir known to be a very holy site for all - Nathu La Pass to Republic of China is nearly 20 kilometers and is optional tour - Back to Gangtok - Evening free to roam around M G Road (Mall) or local Shopping center - Over Night stay at Gangtok

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Pelling)Sight Seeing at Gangtok (Half Day) & Transfer to Pelling
itinerary.text: After breakfast at hotel, depart for Half day city tour of Gangtok - Visit the Directorate of Handicrafts and Handlooms, Research Institute of Tibetology, Chorten (Stupa), Flower Show - Next a drive of 140 kilometers 3 ½ - 4 hours through scenic road – Pelling is situated at an altitude of 2072 meters / 6800 feet - On a clear day guest can get a clear view of Himalayan range with snow capped mount Pandim, Kumbhakarna, Rathong, Khangchendzonga, Zopuno, Shimbho, Narsing, Sinolchu etc - It is one of the exotic settlement with varieties of Rhododendron, Orchids, historical sites, short trek routes and wildlife – Its botanical and zoological richness is inspiring - Yuksom, Ravangla, Rinchenpong and Namchi are some of the tourist spot nearby – Check into hotel - Evening free to roam around the small settlement - Over Night stay atPelling

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Pelling)Pelling Local sightseeing (Full Day)
itinerary.text: After breakfast at hotel – Drive for Full Day Sight Seeing. The routes are forested and the botanical and zoological richness is inspiring. Places of visit are Rimbi water Falls, Rimbi Rock Garden, Kechopalri Lake , it is one of the holy Buddhist lake and it is believed that any wish in front of the lake comes true - Myth is that when a leaf falls on the placid clear water surface, it is picked by a bird and thus the water surface is always free of leaves , Kechopalri Monastery, Kanchenjunga water Falls, Pemayangtse Monastery, Rabdantse ruins, the scenic view from the top of the ruin to the mystic heights of Kanchendzonga ranges is something to be cherished – Back to hotel – Evening free to roam around the helipad or Shopping center - Over Night stay at Pelling

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Darjeeling)Transfer to Darjeeling
itinerary.text: After breakfast at hotel and then forwarding journey to Darjeeling – The road is scenic and pass through Gyalsing and Jorethang - Transferto Darjeeling takes nearly 135 Kilometers 3 – 3 ½ hours – It is situated t an height of 2123 meters / 70001 feet - It is a land of breathtaking beauty, sloping tea gardens with spectacular views of the Mount Everest is the Queen of the hills – Darjeeling is home to many international Schools and few of the internationally famous site like Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Padmaja Naidu Zoological Park, Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, etc – It is also home to the famous World Heritage train – The Darjeeling Himalayan Railway (DHR) - Check into hotel – Evening free - Over Night stay at Darjeeling

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Darjeeling)Darjeeling Local Sight Seeing (Half Day)
itinerary.text: Early morning at around3:45 AM drive to 8000 feet / 2440 meters through primitive forests of oak, magnolia to Tiger Hill to view sunrise over Kanchendzonga Peak (subject to clear weather) – On the way back visit Ghoom Monastery, Peace memorial & Batasia Loop – On the way back visit Ghoom Monastery, Peace memorial & Batasia Loop – Back to hotel for breakfast - After breakfast rest for half an hour After breakfast next round of sight seeing - Half Day city tour includes Padmaja Naidu Zoological Park, Himalayan Mountaineering Institute (Closed on Thursday), Ropeway, Tensing Gumpo Rock, Tibetan Refugee Self Help Center (Closed on Sunday), Tea Estate, Natural History Museum (Sunday Closed), Peace Pagoda – Back to hotel – Evening free to stroll around the area - Overnight stay at Darjeeling

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Darjeeling)Departure – Darjeeling to Siliguri New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) / Tenzing Norgay Bus Stand (Junction) -
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Darjeeling. Our driver takes you down via Mirik, with its lake and tea gardens, to Siliguri (about 105 km, 3½–4 hours), with the drop at New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP), Bagdogra Airport (IXB) or the Tenzing Norgay Bus Stand, as you need. Start early so there is no rush. The tour ends at your drop point.

title: Kovalam Kanyakumari Tour
name: Kovalam Kanyakumari Tour
page_title: Kovalam Kanyakumari Tour 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Explore the southernmost tip of India with our 4-day Kovalam Kanyakumari tour package. Relax on the beaches of Kovalam, visit the Vivekananda Rock Memorial, and experience the beauty of Kanyakumari.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Kovalam)Arrival in Trivandrum and transfer to Kovalam
itinerary.text: Arrive in Thiruvananthapuram (Trivandrum), where our driver meets you and transfers you to Kovalam (about 16 km). After checking in at your hotel, the rest of the day is at leisure. Kovalam is known for its three crescent-shaped beaches; Lighthouse Beach is the liveliest, with cafés and a fine view of the sunset. You can also book an optional Ayurvedic massage, paid directly. Overnight stay in Kovalam.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Kovalam)Kanyakumari day excursion
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, drive to Kanyakumari (about 85 km, 2–3 hours), the southern tip of mainland India where the Arabian Sea, the Bay of Bengal and the Indian Ocean meet. Take the ferry to the Vivekananda Rock Memorial and see the Thiruvalluvar statue (ferry tickets paid locally), and visit the Kumari Amman Temple. En route you can stop at the Padmanabhapuram Palace (closed on Mondays). Watch the sunset if time allows, then return to Kovalam for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kovalam)Trivandrum sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive into Thiruvananthapuram (Trivandrum), about 16 km away, for a half-day city tour. Visit the area of the Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple (entry for Hindus only, with a dress code), the Napier Museum with its Indo-Saracenic architecture, the art gallery nearby, and the Kuthiramalika Palace Museum. Return to Kovalam in the afternoon to relax on the beach or book an optional Ayurvedic massage. Overnight stay in Kovalam.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Trivandrum)Departure from Trivandrum
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and enjoy a last stroll along Lighthouse Beach if time allows. Our driver then transfers you to Trivandrum airport or railway station (about 16 km) for your onward journey, with memories of Kovalam's beaches and the meeting of three seas at Kanyakumari. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Maldives)Arrival - Maldives
itinerary.text: Arrive at Velana International Airport in Malé. You are transferred to your resort by speedboat, seaplane or domestic flight, as arranged for your resort, with views of the islands and the turquoise lagoons. title: Manali with Dharamshala and amritsar
name: Manali with Dharamshala and amritsar
page_title: Manali with Dharamshala and amritsar 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Explore the best of Manali, Dharamshala, and Amritsar with our 5-night, 6-day tour. Enjoy scenic landscapes, local sightseeing, and cultural experiences at destinations like Rohtang Pass, Dal Lake, Golden Temple, and more. Book your Himachal adventure now!

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Manali)Chandigarh to Manali (350 kms/9 hrs)
itinerary.text: Our driver picks you up in Chandigarh for the drive to Manali (about 310 km, 8–9 hours) through the Kullu valley, following the Beas river past Mandi and the Pandoh dam. On arrival in Manali, check in at your hotel. The evening is free to rest or take a short walk on the Mall Road. Dinner and overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Manali)Manali - Local sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast local sightseeing of Manali “HADIMBA TEMPLE” Built in 1553 with a superbly crafted four tiered pagoda roof, it is famous for its exquisitely carved doorway . “CLUB HOUSE” The Club House with its comprehensive facilities that include a roller skating rink, an auditorium, billiards rooms, a library, a bar and restaurant makes wonderful outing for the day.” Tibetan Monastery, Mall Road, Van Vihar, and “VASHIST” Well known for its hot Sulphur springs. There are old temples dedicated to the sage Vashisth and to Lord Rama. Also visit Marhi, Rahalla Falls, Nehru Kund (Cold Water Spring-Named by Late PM Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru). Return back to hotel. Overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Manali)Manali to Excursion to Rohtang Pass (Snow Point)
itinerary.text:
Today enjoy excursion to Rohtang Pass also called Snow point- enjoy the beauty of year round snow caped mountains.Tourists can enjoy Snow Scooter, Ski Ride, mountain biking. Famous tourist spot Rohtang Pass is closed during Jan to April month due to heavy glaciers all around and so tourist activities can be spotted in Solang Valley during that period. Overnight Manali.
Note :Rohtang Pass will be closed on Tuesday. ( Rohtang Pass Sightseeing is not included from 15th May 2015 onwards. It will be chargeable extra payable directly by the guest)

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Dharamshala)Manali to Dharamshala - Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text:
Travel by surface to Mc Leodganj (Dharamsala), magnificently set to the background of the Dhauldhar mountains and the seat of his Holiness, the Dalai Lama, the leader of the Tibetans, since 1960. On arrival check in at hotel. Evening half day city tour visiting Dal Lake, Church, Bhagsu Nag Temple and Tibetan Monastery. Overnight at hotel.
Distance between Manali to Dharamshala is 240 Kms / 7 Hours by road

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Amritsar)Dharamshala to Amritsar via Wagah Border & Local Sightseeing (220 Kms, 6 Hours)
itinerary.text: Early in the morning, check out of your hotel and drive from Dharamshala to Amritsar (about 200 km, 5 hours). In the afternoon, go to the Wagah border to watch the Beating Retreat ceremony. Then check in at your hotel and, in the evening, visit the Golden Temple, beautifully lit at night, and the Jallianwala Bagh memorial nearby. Overnight stay in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Amritsar)Amritsar to Chandigarh Drop(260 Kms )
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Amritsar. If time allows, make a last visit to the Golden Temple in the morning. Then drive to Chandigarh (about 230 km, 5 hours). Our driver drops you at the airport, railway station or bus stand in Chandigarh for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Manali)Manali Arrival - Local Manali - Hotel Stay

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Manali)Manali - Kullu - Mannikaran - Hotel Stay

name: Munnar, Alleppey & Kovalam: Cochin to Trivandrum
page_title: Munnar, Alleppey & Kovalam: Cochin to Trivandrum | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Explore the beauty of Kerala with our 5-day Munnar, Alleppey, and Kovalam tour package. Enjoy the scenic hills of Munnar, backwaters of Alleppey, and beaches of Kovalam.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Munnar)Arrival in Cochin and drive to Munnar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Cochin airport or railway station, where our driver meets you for the drive to Munnar (about 130 km, 4 hours). On the way you pass spice plantations and the Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls. Munnar is surrounded by rolling tea estates and misty hills. After checking in at your hotel, the evening is free to relax or walk in the small town. Overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Munnar)Munnar sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, set out to explore Munnar. Visit Eravikulam National Park, home of the Nilgiri tahr (subject to opening), the Tea Museum, Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point and Kundala Lake, with photo stops among the tea gardens. The afternoon is free to shop for tea, spices and homemade chocolates in town. Return to your hotel for the overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Alleppey)Munnar to Alleppey
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive to Alleppey (about 170 km, 5 hours), the gateway to Kerala's backwaters. In the afternoon you can enjoy a boat ride through the canals in a shikara; the shikara ride is extra and paid directly. You will see paddy fields, coconut groves and villages along the water. Overnight stay in Alleppey.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Kovalam)Alleppey to Kovalam, with Trivandrum sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive south to Thiruvananthapuram (Trivandrum), about 155 km. Visit the Napier Museum, the area of the Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple (entry for Hindus only, with a dress code) and the Kuthiramalika Palace Museum. Then continue to Kovalam (about 16 km), check in at your hotel and relax on the beach in the evening. Overnight stay in Kovalam.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Kovalam)Departure from Trivandrum
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Kovalam. Depending on your travel time, enjoy a last walk on Lighthouse Beach. Our driver then transfers you to Trivandrum airport or railway station (about 16 km) for your onward journey, with memories of Munnar's tea hills, Alleppey's backwaters and Kovalam's beaches. The tour ends here.

page_title: Munnar, Alleppey & Kovalam with Houseboat Stay | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Explore Munnar, Alleppey, and Kovalam with our 6-day Kerala tour package. Book now and experience the best of Kerala's hills, backwaters, and beaches.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Munnar)Arrival in Cochin and drive to Munnar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Cochin airport or railway station, where our driver meets you for the drive to Munnar (about 130 km, 4 hours). The road climbs past spice plantations and waterfalls such as Cheeyappara and Valara. Munnar sits where three mountain streams meet and is surrounded by rolling tea estates. After checking in at your hotel, the evening is free to relax and enjoy the cool hill air. Overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Munnar)Munnar sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, explore Munnar. Visit Eravikulam National Park, home of the endangered Nilgiri tahr (subject to opening), the Tea Museum, and the Mattupetty Dam and Echo Point. Drive through the tea gardens to Kundala Lake and the photo points along the way. The afternoon is free to walk among the tea bushes or shop for tea and spices in town. Return to your hotel for the overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Alleppey)Munnar to Alleppey houseboat
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive to Alleppey (about 170 km, 5 hours) to board your traditional houseboat around noon. Lunch, evening tea and dinner are served on board. Cruise through the narrow backwater canals and Vembanad Lake, passing paddy fields, coconut groves and village life on the banks. The houseboat anchors at dusk for the night. Overnight stay on the houseboat in Alleppey.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Kovalam)Alleppey to Kovalam
itinerary.text: After breakfast on board, the houseboat returns to the jetty around 9 am. Check out and drive south to Kovalam (about 160 km, 4 hours), Kerala's best-known beach town with its crescent-shaped bays. After checking in at your hotel, the rest of the day is free to enjoy the beach and watch the sunset from Lighthouse Beach. Overnight stay in Kovalam.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Kovalam)Trivandrum sightseeing and Kovalam
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Thiruvananthapuram (Trivandrum), about 16 km away. Visit the area around the Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple (entry for Hindus only, with a dress code), the Napier Museum with its art gallery, and the Kuthiramalika Palace Museum, built in traditional Kerala style. Return to Kovalam in the afternoon for a relaxed evening on the beach, or book an optional Ayurvedic massage, paid directly. Overnight stay in Kovalam.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Trivandrum)Departure from Trivandrum
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Kovalam. Depending on your travel time, enjoy a last walk along Lighthouse Beach. Our driver then transfers you to Trivandrum airport or railway station (about 16 km) for your onward journey, with memories of Munnar's tea hills, the Alleppey backwaters and Kovalam. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Mussoorie)Arrive Delhi to Mussoorie ( 310 Kms - 9 Hours)
itinerary.text: Our driver meets you in Delhi for the drive to Mussoorie (about 310 km, 8–9 hours) via Dehradun, climbing into the Garhwal hills. itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Mussoorie)Mussoorie Local Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast proceed to visit famous Kemtey fall is 15Kms approx. from Mussoorie. It is popular tourists point in Mussoorie. Cloud Ends is 7Kms approx. from Mussoorie. It is hightest point of Mussorie offering awesome view to tourists. Camels Back Road is around 3Kms from Mussoorie. As name suggests rocks are shaped like a hump of camel at the end of road. Gun Hill Point is second highest point in Mussoorie. It is also accessible by a cable car. It offers complete view of Mussoorie. Lal Tibba (Red Hills) is located 6Kms from Mussoorie. If is famous among tourists to view sunset and sunrise.Also visit mall road. Back to the hotel. Overnight at Mussoorie.

itinerary.text: On arrival in Bangalore, our driver meets you for the drive to Mysore (about 150 km, 3–4 hours). On the way, visit Srirangapatna, Tipu Sultan's island capital: the Daria Daulat Bagh summer palace, the Gumbaz mausoleum, the fort and the Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple. After checking in at your hotel in Mysore, visit the Brindavan Gardens in the evening for the musical fountain show. Overnight stay in Mysore.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Ooty)Mysore to Ooty
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Mysore to Ooty (about 150 km, 4 hours). The road passes through the Bandipur and Mudumalai forests, where you may spot deer, elephants or peacocks from the road. After checking in at your hotel in Ooty, visit the Government Rose Garden, Ooty Lake, where boating is available, and the Botanical Garden. Overnight stay in Ooty.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Ooty)Ooty & Coonoor Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Coonoor (about 20 km) to visit Sim's Park, Lamb's Rock and Dolphin's Nose, with fine views over the Nilgiri hills and tea gardens. On the way back, stop at a tea factory and museum, see the Ketti Valley viewpoint, and drive up to Doddabetta Peak, the highest point in the Nilgiris. Return to Ooty for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Ooty)Ooty to Bangalore Drop / Coimbatore Drop
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Ooty and drive down the Nilgiri hills to Coimbatore (about 100 km, 3½ hours) or Bangalore (about 290 km, 6–7 hours), whichever suits your onward travel. Our driver drops you at the railway station or airport for your train or flight. The tour ends here.

title: Panorama Ladakh tour
name: Panorama Ladakh Tour
page_title: Panorama Ladakh tour 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Embark on a breathtaking 6 nights and 7 days Ladakh tour. Experience the stunning landscapes, rich culture, and serene monasteries of Ladakh in this immersive travel adventure.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Leh)Arrive Leh - day free to relax and acclimatize
itinerary.text: On your arrival at Leh airport, our representative will meet and transfer you to the Hotel. Check in to the hotel and the rest of the day is for leisure. A complete rest for the day is necessary for the rest of the day to accustom you and to the obscure air at the high altitude. Leh is situated at the height of 11563 feet. Evening visit Shanti Stupa. Later visit the market (stay for 01hour only). Return back to the hotel for Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Leh)LEH – Excursion to Sham Valley Upto Sangam; Monastery Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive west from Leh through the Sham valley along the Indus. Stop at the Hall of Fame war museum, Gurudwara Pathar Sahib and Magnetic Hill, where vehicles seem to roll uphill, and continue to the Sangam, where the Zanskar river meets the Indus. On the way back, visit one of the region's monasteries such as Spituk or Phyang. Return to Leh for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Nubra Valley)Leh–Nubra Valley Via Khardunga La 18,390 FT. (120 KMS / 5 – 6 HRS)
itinerary.text:
Post breakfast drives to Nubra Valley. The road journey from Leh to Nubra Valley passes over Khardung La (The Highest Motorable Road In The World) at 5,602 Mtrs / 18,390 Ft, around 39 km from Leh. From the pass, one can see all the way south over the Indus valley to seemingly endless peaks and ridges of the Zanskar range, and north to the giants of the Sasser massif. Nubra Valley is popularly known as Ldumra or the valley of flowers. It is situated in the north of Ladakh between the Karakoram and Ladakh ranges of the Himalayas. The average altitude of the valley is 10,000 Ft. above sea level.
Upon arrival in Nubra, we check in at our Camp / Hotel in Hunder for Overnight stay. In the evening you can walk around the tiny villages to see how the locals live in this part of the world. A visit to a Ladakhi home can be arranged. Overnight Stay at the Camp or Hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Leh)Nubra Valley – LEH
itinerary.text:
It is indeed a strange sight as one side of the road are rocky mountains that characterize the Ladakhi landscape and in the distance can be seen snow-capped mountains. On the return stop at Diskit which is the headquarter town of Nubra Valley. Stroll around the bazaar observing the shops and local people going about their daily chores. Diskit is famous for 515 years old Buddhist Monastery, lying magnificently situated on a hilltop, facing the entire Valley.
Later drive back to Leh in the late afternoon via Khardungla Top. On arrival at Leh, you will check in to your Hotel. In the afternoon you can rest and relax. Overnight at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Pangong)Leh to Pangong Lake (140 KMS / 4 - 5 HRS – ONE WAY)
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, we leave for Pangong Lake en route visiting Shey Palace, The ancient capital of Ladakh & 3 Idiots Rancho School& further 5 Kms Driving through a picturesque landscape and reach Thiksey, an impressive complex rising tier upon tier on a hill above the village. After visiting two monasteries we drive further towards Changla Pass 5486 Mtrs. The long easy ascent takes you to Changla pass through its winding roads passing through Sakti Village. Stop at the Changla Pass for a quick photo session and drive down to the village of Tangtse, where you can relax for a cup of tea. Leaving Tangtse for Pangong you pass through few small villages of Changthang and finally, you can have a sudden view of the Pangong Lake situated at 14,000 feet (4,267 m). This famous blue brackish Lake of Pangong is 5/6 Kms wide and over 133 Kms long with half of its running the other side of the "Indo China Border". One rarely feels so close to nature and environment and the scenery is unforgettable. Upon arrival, check-in at the Camp Near Pangong lake. Dinner & Overnight at the Camp.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Leh)Pangong Lake To Leh (140 KMS / 6 HRS)
itinerary.text:
Morning at leisure to explore the beauty of the lake and later we drive back to Leh en route visiting Hemis Gompa, the largest monastic foundation of Drukpa Kagyu Order of Tibetan Buddhism. Drive further to Leh and check in at our hotel for Overnight
In the evening you can stroll around the marketplace for some last minute souvenir shopping.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Leh)Departure from Leh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Leh. Depending on your flight time, you may have a little time for last-minute shopping in Leh market for pashmina, apricots or Tibetan handicrafts. Our driver then transfers you to Leh airport (Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport) for your flight home. The tour ends here.

title: Serene Leh Ladakh Tour
name: Serene Leh Ladakh Tour
page_title: Serene Leh Ladakh Tour 7 Nights / 8 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Embark on a breathtaking 6 nights and 7 days Ladakh tour. Experience the stunning landscapes, rich culture, and serene monasteries of Ladakh in this immersive travel adventure.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Leh)Leh Arrival
itinerary.text: Arrive at Leh's Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport, where our representative meets you and transfers you to your hotel. Leh is at about 3,500 m, so the rest of the day is for rest and acclimatisation, with welcome tea or coffee at the hotel. In the evening, if you feel well, visit the Shanti Stupa for sunset views, then stroll through Leh market. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Leh)Leh-Excursion to Monastries-Leh
itinerary.text: Post Breakfast we proceed for Indus Valley Monastery Starting with Hemis Gompa, the largest monastic foundation of Drukpa Kagyu Order of Tibetan Buddhism, Thiksey Monastery an impressive complex rising tier upon tier on a hill above the village, Shey Palace, The ancient capital of Ladakh, 3 Idiots Rancho School & Sindhu Ghat. After visiting these places we drive back to Leh. Evening at leisure to explore the city on your own. Dinner & Overnight at the Hotel

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Nubra Valley)Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive from Leh to Nubra Valley (about 120 km, 5–6 hours) over the Khardung La pass, one of the highest motorable passes in the world. Descend into the valley of the Shyok and Nubra rivers, with sand dunes, apricot orchards and small villages. In the afternoon, visit the dunes at Hunder, where you can ride a double-humped Bactrian camel at your own cost. Overnight stay in a camp or hotel in Nubra.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Leh)Nubra Valley to Leh (120 km / 4–5 hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Diskit Monastery, the oldest in Nubra, with its large Maitreya Buddha statue overlooking the valley. Then drive back to Leh (about 120 km, 4–5 hours) over Khardung La. On arrival, check in at your hotel and spend the evening at leisure in Leh market. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Pangong)Leh to Pangong Lake (140 km / 4–5 hours)
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, drive from Leh to Pangong Lake (about 140 km, 4–5 hours) over the Chang La pass, stopping on the way at Thiksey or Shey monastery if you wish. Pangong stretches into Tibet and changes colour from blue to green with the light. Spend the afternoon by the shore and watch the sunset over the lake. Overnight stay in a camp at Pangong.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Leh)Pangong Lake -Leh
itinerary.text: Wake early to see the colours of Pangong Lake in the morning light, then enjoy some time by the shore. After breakfast, drive back to Leh (about 140 km, 5–6 hours) over the Chang La pass. On arrival, check in at your hotel. In the evening, stroll around Leh market on your own for last-minute souvenir shopping. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Leh)Leh-Excursion to Sham Valley-Leh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, you drive downstream along the River Indus on Leh – Kargil Highway. And start your sightseeing with Hall of Fame (Museum Constructed by India Army) near Leh is worth a visit for every Indian, and proceed further to Gurudwara Patthar Sahib. Nestled deep in the Himalayas, a drive of another 4 km will take you to Magnetic Hill which defies the law of gravity & further driving through a picturesque landscape reach the Confluence Of The Indus And Zanskar River. After visiting above places drive back to Leh enroute visiting Spituk Monastery, Built in the 15th century during the reign of Grags ‘bum-lde, this new Gelug-pa monastery was built like a fortress on the summit of crags. Evening at leisure and Overnight at Hotel in Leh

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Leh)Departure from Leh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel. Depending on your flight time, you may have a little time for last-minute shopping in Leh market for pashmina, apricots or Tibetan handicrafts. Our representative then drops you at Leh airport for your onward flight; the departure transfer is included. The Serene Leh Ladakh tour ends here.

title: Shimla Manali Tour
name: Shimla Manali Tour
page_title: Shimla Manali Tour 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Embark on a 5-night, 6-day Shimla and Manali tour. Explore scenic landscapes, visit historic temples, and experience thrilling activities in Kufri, Solang Valley, and Rohtang Pass. Book your Himachal adventure now!

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Shimla)Arrival Delhi / Chandigarh to Shimla
itinerary.text: Our driver meets you in Delhi or Chandigarh for the drive up to Shimla, the summer capital of British India, through the Shivalik foothills and pine forests. After checking in at your hotel, the rest of the day is free. In the evening, walk along the Mall Road and the Ridge, with Christ Church, Scandal Point and views over the valleys, and plenty of cafés and shops. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Shimla)Shimla: Full day sightseeing
itinerary.text: Today breakfast proceed for in and around sightseeing of SHIMLA, visit KUFRI, India's one of the best holiday paradise Kufri in Shimla is beautifully tucked on an altitude of 2,622 meter. The place is a tourist hotspot for its awesome scenic and sports activities. Evening free to stroll in the famous shopping place of Shimla town - “THE MALL & THE RIDGE” This large open space in the heart of town presents excellent views of the mountain ranges. Also visit Jakhoo Temple and Hanuman Temple. Shimla's landmarks - the neo- gothic structure of Christ Church (built in 1850's) and the neo - Tudor library building - are worth seeing. Overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Manali)Shimla to Kullu Manali
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Shimla to Manali (about 280 km, 9–10 hours) through the Kullu valley. On the way, see Sundernagar lake, the Pandoh dam on the Beas river and the Vaishno Devi temple near Kullu. The road follows the Beas through gorges and apple orchards. On arrival in Manali, check in at your hotel and rest. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Manali)Manali - Local sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast local sightseeing of Manali “HADIMBA TEMPLE” Built in 1553 with a superbly crafted four tiered pagoda roof, it is famous for its exquisitely carved doorway . “CLUB HOUSE” The Club House with its comprehensive facilities that include a roller skating rink, an auditorium, billiards rooms, a library, a bar and restaurant makes wonderful outing for the day.” Tibetan Monastery, Mall Road, Van Vihar, and “VASHIST” Well known for its hot Sulphur springs. There are old temples dedicated to the sage Vashisth and to Lord Rama. Also visit Marhi, Rahalla Falls, Nehru Kund (Cold Water Spring-Named by Late PM Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru). Return back to hotel. Overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Manali)Manali to Excursion to Rohtang Pass (Snow Point)
itinerary.text:
Today enjoy excursion to Rohtang Pass also called Snow point- enjoy the beauty of year round snow caped mountains.Tourists can enjoy Snow Scooter, Ski Ride, mountain biking. Famous tourist spot Rohtang Pass is closed during Jan to April month due to heavy glaciers all around and so tourist activities can be spotted in Solang Valley during that period. Overnight Manali.
Note:Rohtang Pass will be closed on Tuesday. ( Rohtang Pass Sightseeing is not included from 15th May 2015 onwards. It will be chargeable extra payable directly by the guest)

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Manali)Manali to Chandigarh (390 Kms, 9 Hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Manali and drive by private cab back down the Kullu valley to Chandigarh (about 310 km, 9 hours). On arrival, our driver drops you at the railway station, bus stand or airport, as included in your package, for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

description: Enjoy an 8-day journey through Shimla, Manali, Dalhousie, and Amritsar. Explore hill stations, historical landmarks, and cultural sites, including Rohtang Pass, Khajjiar, and the Golden Temple. Perfect for those seeking a comprehensive Himachal and Punjab experience.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Shimla)Arrival Delhi & Delhi to Shimla
itinerary.text: Our driver meets you in Delhi (about 380 km, 9 hours) for the drive up to Shimla, the summer capital of British India, through the Shivalik foothills and pine forests. After checking in at your hotel, the rest of the day is free. In the evening, walk along the Mall Road and the Ridge, with Christ Church, Scandal Point and views over the valleys, and plenty of cafés and shops. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Shimla)Shimla: Full day sightseeing
itinerary.text: Today breakfast proceed for in and around sightseeing of SHIMLA, visit KUFRI, India's one of the best holiday paradise Kufri in Shimla is beautifully tucked on an altitude of 2,622 meter. The place is a tourist hotspot for its awesome scenic and sports activities. Evening free to stroll in the famous shopping place of Shimla town - “THE MALL & THE RIDGE” This large open space in the heart of town presents excellent views of the mountain ranges. Also visit Jakhoo Temple and Hanuman Temple. Shimla's landmarks - the neo- gothic structure of Christ Church (built in 1850's) and the neo - Tudor library building - are worth seeing. Overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Manali)Shimla to Kullu Manali
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Shimla to Manali (about 280 km, 9–10 hours) through the Kullu valley. itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Manali)Manali - Local sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast local sightseeing of Manali “HADIMBA TEMPLE” Built in 1553 with a superbly crafted four tiered pagoda roof, it is famous for its exquisitely carved doorway . “CLUB HOUSE” The Club House with its comprehensive facilities that include a roller skating rink, an auditorium, billiards rooms, a library, a bar and restaurant makes wonderful outing for the day.” Tibetan Monastery, Mall Road, Van Vihar, and “VASHIST” Well known for its hot Sulphur springs. Overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Dalhousie)Manali to Dalhousie

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Dalhousie)Dalhousie Local Sightseeing - Khajjiar Tour

Golden TempleThe most important sikh shrine which is also called Mecca for the Sikhs is a living symbol of the spiritual and historical traditions of the Sikhs.

Distance between Dalhousie to Amritsar is 220 Kms / 6 Hours by road

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Srinagar)Arrival in Srinagar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Srinagar airport, where our driver meets you and transfers you to your houseboat on Dal Lake or Nigeen Lake. Dinner and overnight stay on the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Srinagar)Srinagar sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, set out on a half-day tour of Srinagar's Mughal gardens: Nishat Bagh, the "garden of pleasure", Shalimar Bagh, laid out by Emperor Jahangir, and the terraced Chashme Shahi spring garden. Depending on time, you can also visit the Hazratbal shrine on the banks of Dal Lake. The rest of the afternoon is free for the local markets, known for pashmina, papier-mâché and dry fruits. Return to Srinagar for dinner and the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Gulmarg)Srinagar to Gulmarg
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive to Gulmarg (about 56 km, 2 hours), a meadow resort ringed by snow-capped peaks. After checking in, enjoy the open meadows on foot or by pony. itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Pahalgam)Gulmarg to Pahalgam
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive to Pahalgam (about 150 km, 4–5 hours) in the Lidder valley. itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Pahalgam)Pahalgam sightseeing
itinerary.text: A full day to explore Pahalgam and its valleys. Popular excursions include Aru Valley, Betaab Valley and Chandanwari, the starting point of the Amarnath Yatra; these are reached by local union vehicles, paid directly. You can also take a gentle pony ride to Baisaran meadow, often called "mini Switzerland". Alternatively, relax by the Lidder river and enjoy the quiet of the valley. Return to your hotel in the evening for dinner and the overnight stay in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Srinagar)Pahalgam to Srinagar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive back to Srinagar (about 95 km, 3 hours). After checking in at your hotel or houseboat, the afternoon is free. You can visit the old city and the Jamia Masjid, shop for Kashmiri handicrafts at the government emporium, or take a sunset shikara ride on Dal Lake if you did not do so on the first day. This is a relaxed last evening in the valley. Overnight stay in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Srinagar)Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out at leisure. Depending on your flight time, you may have a little time for last-minute shopping for saffron, walnuts or shawls. itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Srinagar)Srinagar to Pahalgam day trip (186 km)

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Pahalgam)Arrival Srinagar Airport to Pahalgam
itinerary.text: Arrival on Srinagar Airport you will be met our representative and transfer from Srinagar to Pahalgam by taxi for 02 nights stay. Pahalgam (2133 mts ) also known as ‘The valley of Shepherds or Trekker's Paradise. Pahalgam is the most famous place for Indian Film Industry. On the way visit Awantipura ruins, Saffron fields One of the most beautiful places on earth, the town of Pahalgam offers breath-taking views. One can just enjoy the town of Pahalgam trek to some of the most beautiful places on earth. Pahalgam is also the entry point for the famous Amarnath Cave, a holy site for Hindus. Overnight in hotel in Pahalgam

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Pahalgam)Pahalgam Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text: A full day in Pahalgam to explore the valley and its surroundings. You can hire a pony to ride to Baisaran meadow, often called "mini Switzerland", and other viewpoints such as Kashmir Valley point and Dabian; pony rides are paid locally. Local union vehicles can take you to Aru Valley, Betaab Valley and Chandanwari at extra cost. Overnight stay in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Gulmarg)Pahalgam to Gulmarg
itinerary.text: After early breakfast at hotel drive from Pahalgam to Gulmarg by taxi for overnight stay. (8700 ft i.e. 2652 mts ), Discovered by the Kashmiri romantic poet in the 16th century who was inspired with its grassy slopes covered with wild flowers. In winter Gulmarg looks more beautiful due to heavy snow fall. And turns into India's premier Ski resort in winter. The Gondola Cable Car (optional) offers rides to the upland meadows of Kongdori and beyond to the top of Apharwat range to a height of 14000 ft for viewing the Himalayan Peaks in summer and for downhill skiing in winter. One can have Gondola ride (cable car directly payable) from Gulmarg to Khalinmarg . Overnight in hotel in Gulmarg.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Srinagar)Gulmarg to Srinagar
itinerary.text:
After breakfast at hotel drive from Gulmarg to Srinagar by taxi for overnight stay. Check in at deluxe houseboat.
Later on proceed to famous Nishat Garden known as ‘Garden of pleasure' built in 16th century (1633) by Mughal King Asif Khan. Then visiting Shalimar Garden known as ‘Garden of love' built in 16th century (1619) by Mughal King Jehangir for his beloved wife Noor Jehan or ( Mehr -un- Nissa ). Evening enjoy the Shikara Ride on the famous Dal Lake to enjoy the beauty that God has graced this city, which is often compared to Venice. You will get a lovely view of some interesting places around the lake. Overnight stay in deluxe houseboat in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Srinagar)Srinagar to Sonmarg Tour (Day Trip) 196 Kms
itinerary.text: Full day excursion to Sonmarg Tour which is the most beautiful drive from Srinagar. On the way we stop at many beautiful spots. Continue drive to Sonmarg 2690 Mtrs (Meadow of Gold). One can ride on horse to visit Thajiwas Glacier where snow remains round the year and Sonmarg is known as Gateway of Ladakh . In the evening return to Houseboat. Overnight at Hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Srinagar)Srinagar – Departure
itinerary.text: After breakfast at your houseboat or hotel, visit the Shankaracharya Temple on its hilltop overlooking Dal Lake and Srinagar, a short climb of steps from the car park. Then our driver transfers you to Srinagar airport for your onward flight, with plenty of memories of Pahalgam, Gulmarg, Sonmarg and the lakes of Srinagar. The tour ends here.

itinerary.text: Arrive at Dubai International Airport on your included flight from Delhi. Our representative meets you and you transfer to your hotel by shared seat-in-coach. description: Escape to Goa with our 3 Nights / 4 Days Sun Kissed Goa Escape package. Explore the city's stunning beaches, vibrant nightlife, and rich cultural heritage. Book now and experience the best of Goa

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Guirim)Arrival in Goa
itinerary.text: On arrival in Goa, our representative meets and greets you and transfers you to your hotel in Guirim, a quiet village in North Goa within easy reach of the beaches of Calangute and Baga. A welcome drink is served on arrival. After checking in, the rest of the day is at leisure to relax by the pool or take a first walk to the beach. Breakfast is included each morning. Overnight stay in Guirim.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Guirim)Jeep safari to Dudhsagar Falls
itinerary.text: After breakfast, set out on a full-day excursion to Dudhsagar Falls on the Goa–Karnataka border, one of India's tallest waterfalls. The last stretch through the Bhagwan Mahavir Sanctuary is by jeep safari on a sharing basis, as included in your package. You can swim in the pool at the base of the falls (in season), and many tours stop at a spice plantation on the way back. Overnight stay in Guirim.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Guirim)Panaji city tour and temples
itinerary.text: After breakfast, set out on a tour of Panaji (Panjim) and the temples of central Goa. Visit the Shri Mangeshi Temple and the Balaji temple, set among hills and paddy fields. In Panaji, walk through the Latin quarter of Fontainhas with its colourful Portuguese-era houses and see the Church of Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception. Return to Guirim in the evening. Overnight stay in Guirim.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Guirim)Fort Aguada and departure
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel. On the way to the airport or station, visit Fort Aguada, the 17th-century Portuguese fort and lighthouse overlooking the Mandovi river mouth and Sinquerim beach. Depending on your travel time, you may stop for a last Goan meal. You are then transferred for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

description: Experience the best of Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, and Pattaya on our 8 nights/9 days tour package. Explore vibrant cities, enjoy sightseeing tours, and relax in comfortable accommodations. Book now and create unforgettable memories

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Singapore)Arrival in Singapore
itinerary.text: Welcome to Singapore. On arrival at Changi Airport, our local representative meets you and transfers you privately to your hotel, the Hotel Boss. The rest of the day is free. In the evening you can visit Marina Bay to see the skyline and the Spectra light and water show (free), or walk along Clarke Quay by the river. Overnight stay in Singapore.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Singapore)Singapore sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, explore Singapore on your own. Popular sights include the Merlion and Marina Bay, Gardens by the Bay with its Supertree Grove, Chinatown and Little India, and the shopping on Orchard Road; attraction tickets are paid locally. The city's efficient MRT makes it easy to get around. The rest of the day is at leisure. Overnight stay in Singapore.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kuala Lumpur)Singapore-Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the coach terminal for your onward journey to Kuala Lumpur on your own (about 5–6 hours by coach). On arrival, our local representative meets you and transfers you to the Grand Seasons hotel. The rest of the day is free; in the evening you can see the Petronas Twin Towers lit up. Overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Kuala Lumpur)Kuala Lumpur sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, explore Kuala Lumpur on your own. Popular sights include the Petronas Twin Towers, Merdeka Square with its colonial buildings, the National Mosque, the Batu Caves temple outside the city and the shopping streets of Bukit Bintang; attraction tickets are paid locally. The rest of the day is at leisure. Overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Pattaya)Kuala Lumpur-Pattaya
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight to Bangkok on your own. On arrival, our local representative meets you and drives you to Pattaya (about 2 hours), where you check in at the Nova Platinum hotel. The rest of the day is free; in the evening you can explore Walking Street or the beach road. Overnight stay in Pattaya.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Pattaya)Pattaya sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, explore Pattaya on your own. Popular choices include a speedboat trip to Coral Island (Koh Larn) for its beaches, the Sanctuary of Truth wooden temple, Nong Nooch tropical garden and the floating market; tickets are paid locally. Or simply relax by the pool or on the beach. Overnight stay in Pattaya.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Bangkok)Pattaya to Bangkok
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and our driver takes you to Bangkok (about 155 km, 2½ hours), with breaks for refreshments and photographs along the way.
