title: Yamunotri Gangotri Do Dham Yatra from Delhi
name: Do Dham Tour Package
page_title: Yamunotri Gangotri Do Dham Yatra from Delhi | Sacred Pilgrimage Tour
description: Embark on a spiritual journey with the Yamunotri Gangotri Do Dham Yatra from Delhi. Explore the holy shrines of Yamunotri and Gangotri, surrounded by the serene beauty of the Himalayas. Book your Do Dham pilgrimage package today!

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival At Delhi And Drive To Haridwar
itinerary.text:
On your arrival at Delhi airport, our airport representative will welcome and escort you to Haridwar. Upon arrival at Haridwar, check into your hotel. Then, in the evening, you can engage in Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri on your own, if possible, with available time and conditions. Enjoy the evening roaming around this spiritual town. We will spend the night at Haridwar.
POSSIBLE SIGHT-SEEING TODAY: Har Ki Pauri or Other sights on the edge of Ganga on your own.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Haridwar To Barkot Via Mussoorie
itinerary.text:
After having early morning breakfast, we take a bath in Ganga. Generally, we drive for approximately seven hours with a comfortable ride, stopping for short break at Kempty fall, if preferred. Otherwise, we will move continuously without stopping, and we can reach within six hours. Mostly, during peak season, there will be a massive rush in Mussoorie, so sometimes we divert the way to Barkot via Vikas Nagar. If we need to redirect the way, we should leave sightseeing around Kempty falls while returning. On our way, we will be visiting places such as Satya Narayan Temple in Haridwar, Prakasheshwar temple in Dehradun, and Kempty fall in Mussoorie. After reaching Barkot, we will check into the hotel, have dinner, and retire for the night.
POSSIBLE SIGHT-SEEING TODAY: Har Ki Pauri or Other sights on the edge of Ganga on your own.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Barkot To Yamunotri, Return To Barkot
itinerary.text:
Waking up early morning, we leave for Jankichatti through Hanuman Chatti and Phool Chatti. Firstly, we will drive to Hanuman Chatti, from here we need to take local jeeps for Janki Chatti. Taking vehicles helps to reduce the distance to walk by about 8km. If you take the automobile, you will be trekking from Janki Chatti. You need to travel for 6km from here to reach Yamunotri. You will also have the choice of taking a horse or Doli. However, you need to do it on your own expense. Upon arrival at Yamunotri, most people cook rice by packing it in a cloth and dipping it in the natural hot water of the hot Kund. Pilgrims take this rice home as “Prasad.”
Also, you can take a bath in the natural warm water of Jamunabai Kund; you can offer prayer near the temple to Divya Shila. Then, you can move to the temple of Goddess Yamuna and offer your prayers before returning to Barkot. After offering prayers and enjoying the surrounding view, we trek back to Janki Chatti. Then, we will drive back to Barkot, where we will spend the night.
HANUMAN CHATTI: Hanuman Chatti is the confluence of Hanuman Ganga and Yamuna River.
YAMUNOTRI TEMPLE: Maharani Gularia of Jaipur built Yamunotri Temple in the 19th century. This temple has been destroyed and rebuilt a couple of times in the last hundred years.
SURYA KUND: Surya Kund is one of the numerous natural thermal springs in the surrounding area of the temple, which flows into several pools. Surya Kund is the most important among these multitudes of thermal springs.
DIVYA SHILA: Divya Shila is a rock pillar. There is a norm of worshipping Divya Shillal before entering the Yamunotri temple.
POSSIBLE SIGHT-SEEING TODAY: Janki Chatti, Bhairav Baba Temple, Yamunotri Temple, Tapt Kund– Return Via Synachatti, Ranachatti

itinerary.title: Day 4: Barkot To Uttarkashi
itinerary.text:
We will start our trip around 10 AM after having a delicious breakfast. As you might be tired due to the trek to Yamunotri, you can rest on the bus as we will be driving for around 4 hours to reach Uttarkashi. You can rest entirely on the van; the further trip will be even more tiring as we will be traveling between our destination most of the time. Driving for about four hours, we will reach Uttarkashi. Uttarkashi lies at the bank of the river Bhagirathi. On our arrival at Uttarkashi, we will pay a visit to Vishwanath Temple. There is a large iron trident erected in the Vishwanath Temple. Other famous temples in this area are Ekadash Rudra, Bhairav, Gyaneshwar, and Goddess Kuteti Devi. Visiting Vishwanath Temple, we will check in the hotel and enjoy the evening resting.
POSSIBLE SIGHT-SEEING TODAY: Shiv Gufa, Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Shakti Temple or Nearby Area if possible.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Uttarkashi To Ganganani To Gangotri To Harsil, Return To Uttarkashi
itinerary.text:
We will leave Uttarkashi early in the morning. On the way to Gangotri, we will visit places like Tapt Kund (a hot water spring) and Harsil village. We can also witness some magnificent views of the Himalayas. After praying at Gangotri, we will return to Uttarkashi, where we will spend the night.
GANGOTRI: Built around the 18th century, Gangotri temple is a temple dedicated to Goddess Ganga. Gorkha General Amar Singh Thapa built the temple. The temple lies near a sacred stone where King Bhagirath worshipped Lord Shiva. The sacred stone is Shivling, which is submerged in the river. This natural rock Shivling is the spot where, according to mythology, Lord Shiva sat when he received Ganga in his tangled lock. The stone is most visible during winter months when the water level decreases. There is another legend that Pandavas performed the great Deva Yagna here to atone their sins of killing their kin in the massive battle of Mahabharata. The temple is an exotic structure with a height of 20ft, made of white granite.
KEDAR GANGA SANGAM: About a hundred Yards from the Ganga Temple, the river Kedar Ganga flows. Starting from the Kedar Valle, this river meets the Bhagirathi on its left bank.
GANGNANI: If you walk further up from Gangotri, you will see a hot water spring at Gangnani. There is a Kund called Rishikund where you can have a rejuvenating bath at natural hot water spring. There is also a temple of the Sage Parashar near the spring. The sage Parashar is believed to be the father of Ved Vyas.
RITUAL AND ACTIVITIES: Perform Snan at Gangotri Ghat (VIP Ghat), Ganga Pujan & Aarti at Gangotri Ghat, Darshan of Bhagirath Shila, Darshan of Gauri Ganesha Temple, Finally Gangotri Temple Darshan after that you will offer prayer to Surya Kund. While returning from Gupteshwar Mahadev temple in Dharali, communicate with Tibetan people and learn more about their culture in Harsil.
POSSIBLE SIGHT-SEEING TODAY: Gangnani Kund, Harsil, Gangotri Temple

itinerary.title: Day 6: Uttarkashi To Rishikesh To Haridwar
itinerary.text:
Uttarkashi To Rishikesh To Haridwar After having early morning breakfast, we depart towards Rishikesh. On the way, we will get the gorgeous view of Tehri Lake. Rishikesh is a famous sacred town on the bank of Ganga. Shivalik range of the Himalayas bounds it on three sides. There is a belief that Raibhya Rishi did hard penance here, and the god named Rishikesh appeared, henceforth the name came to be known as Rishikesh. Upon arriving at Rishikesh, we will visit Laxman Jhula and Ram Jhula on foot, as the vehicle won’t reach these places. The car will be waiting for you in the parking area. It is ideal for visiting this part of Rishikesh is by entering through Laxman Jhula and exiting from Ram Jhula. Likewise, you can see several Ghats, temples, and beautiful ashrams. Rishikesh is the second significant place for Sadhus and Saints. The site is also known as the Capital land of Yoga. If you missed Ganga Aarti before, you could engage in it after arriving at Haridwar. So, it depends on you if you want to explore around and reach Har KI Pauri, Haridwar, for Ganga Aarti. The Ganga Aarti typically starts by 6 PM in summer seasons, and 5:15 PM in winters. Those who did it before can enjoy some more time in Rishikesh and sightsee around. Or you can reach Haridwar and visit this beautiful place. As this is the last day of your trip, you can enjoy shopping in Haridwar.
POSSIBLE SIGHT-SEEING TODAY: Enroute cross Srinagar Via Dhari Devi Temple, Kirtinagar, Deo Prayag, Rishikesh, Haridwar.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Return To Delhi
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, we will leave for Delhi and proceed to your destination as per your schedule. On the route, we can visit places like Daksh Temple, Shri Yantra Temple, and Maya Devi Temple. However, there is no sightseeing included in Delhi. If you want to explore Delhi, we can manage an experienced guide for you to enjoy the trip to Delhi.

title: Amritsar, Dharamshala and Dalhousie with Jwalamukhi and Chintpurni
name: Amritsar, Dharamshala and Dalhousie with Jwalamukhi and Chintpurni
page_title: Amritsar, Dharamshala and Dalhousie with Jwalamukhi and Chintpurni 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: A 5-night, 6-day tour from Amritsar: the Golden Temple and Wagah Border, then the Chintpurni and Jwalamukhi temples on the way to two nights in Dharamshala and McLeod Ganj, and two nights in Dalhousie with a Khajjiar day trip.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Amritsar)Arrive Amritsar – Golden Temple, Jallianwala Bagh and Wagah Border
itinerary.text: Arrive Amritsar, transfer to hotel and check in. Visit the Golden Temple and later visit the massacre of Jalian Wallan Bagh. Afternoon little free time to rest and evening around 3 PM drive to Wagah Border to see the Closing Ceremony, event starts exactly by 5.30 PM everyday. Border closing 'lowering of the flags' ceremony is a daily military practice that the security forces of India and Pakistan.This ceremony takes place every evening before sunset at the Wagah border, which as part of the Grand Trunk Road was the only road link between these two countries before the opening of the Aman Setu in Kashmir in 1999. The ceremony starts with a blustering parade by the soldiers from both the sides and ends up in the perfectly coordinated lowering of the two nations flags, it is called the beating retreat border ceremony on the international level. One infantryman (Jawan) stands at attention on each side of the gate. As the sun sets, the iron gate at the border is opened and the flags are lowered. The flags are folded and the ceremony ends with a retreat that involves a brusque handshake between soldiers from either side. Return back to Hotel and Overnight

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Dharamshala)Amritsar to Dharamshala via the Chintpurni and Jwalamukhi temples
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive into the Himachal foothills. The first stop is the Chintpurni Temple (about 170 km from Amritsar), one of the 51 Shaktipeeths, for darshan. Continue about 35 km to the Jwalamukhi Temple, known for its eternal natural flames, then drive on through the Kangra valley to Dharamshala (about 55 km). It is a long day — about 260 km in all, 8–9 hours with the darshan stops. Check in on arrival. Overnight stay in Dharamshala.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Dharamshala)Dharamshala and McLeod Ganj sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, go up to McLeod Ganj, the seat of the Dalai Lama. Visit the Tsuglagkhang temple complex, walk to the Bhagsunag temple and waterfall, and see the church of St. John in the Wilderness among the deodar trees. Later, see the cricket stadium in Dharamshala with the Dhauladhar range behind it. The evening is free in the McLeod Ganj market for Tibetan handicrafts and cafés. Overnight stay in Dharamshala.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Dalhousie)Dharamshala to Dalhousie
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive to Dalhousie (about 120 km, 4–5 hours) through the Kangra and Chamba foothills. Dalhousie is spread over five hills among pine and deodar forests. After checking in, walk the Mall Road between Gandhi Chowk and Subhash Chowk in the evening. Overnight stay in Dalhousie.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Dalhousie)Khajjiar day trip
itinerary.text: After breakfast, take a day trip to Khajjiar (about 24 km), a wide meadow ringed by deodar forest with a small lake and the Khajji Nag temple. The road passes the Kalatop forest. Return to Dalhousie in the afternoon; if time allows, visit the Panchpula and Satdhara springs. Overnight stay in Dalhousie.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Dalhousie to Amritsar drop (about 210 km, 6 hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive back down to Amritsar (about 210 km, 6 hours) via Pathankot. Drop at the Amritsar railway station, airport or a hotel for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Mysuru)Bangalore to Mysore Sightseeing
itinerary.text:

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Coorg)Mysore to Coorg
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Mysore to Coorg (Kodagu), about 120 km. itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Coorg)Coorg Local Sightseeing

On arrival in Bangalore, our driver drops you at the airport or railway station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Cochin Munnar Thekkady Alleppey
name: Cochin Munnar Thekkady Alleppey
page_title: Cochin Munnar Thekkady Alleppey | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Explore the beauty of Kerala with our 6-day Cochin, Munnar, Thekkedy, and Alleppey tour package. Enjoy the scenic hills of Munnar, wildlife of Thekkedy, and backwaters of Alleppey.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Cochin)Arrive Cochin to Cochin Local & Stay
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Cochin Airport / Railway Station. Transfer to Hotel. Check in to the Hotel. ofOvernight Stay at the Hotel.
Sightseeingd :-Fort cochin, navy museum, St. Francis church, Chinese fishing net, Santa clause basilica, Mattanchery palace, Jewish synagogue, Marian drive, Marine walk way, boating, Tripunitura hill palace. You can find some time for shopping at Cochin,Dutch Palace, Jewish Synagogue, Fort Kochi Beach , Chinese fishing Net etc.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Munnar)Cochin to Munnar
itinerary.text:
Check out from hotel and leave for Munnar. Upon arrival check in at hotel. Munnar is located at the confluence of 03 rivers as the very name signifies. The sprawling tea plantations and picturesque towns make Munnar a popular hill resort town in South India. Evening at leisure. Overnight stay at the Hotel.
Sightseeingd :-Enroute visit Kodanadu elephant care centre, Cheyyara waterfalls, Valara waterfalls, Attukadu waterfalls, Spice plantations etc.
Distance between Cochin to Munnar is 135 Kms (3.5 hours) by road

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Munnar)Munnar Local sightseeing
itinerary.text:
In the morning start the sightseeing of Munnar visiting the tea plantations, Tea Museum, the Eravikulam National park home of the endangered Niligiri Thar (Ibex), followed by visit to the Mattupetty dam, the the Kundala Lake and other scenic spots. Overnight stay at the Hotel.
Sightseeingd :-Eravikulam National Park (Raja Malai), mattupetty dam, tea estates, eco point, spice plantation, rose garden, photo point, honey bee tree, tea museum, blossom park, kundale dam and top station

itinerary.title: Day 4 :(Thekkady)Munnar to Thekkady
itinerary.text:
Morning transfer to Thekkady (Periyar) (4 hrs drive). Thekkady has one of the world's most fascinating natural wildlife reserves noted for its geography, diverse wildlife and scenic beauty. Arive at Thekkady and check-in at Hotel: Later afternoon boat ride on the Lake Periyar where one can have a unique experience of viewing wildlife at close quarters from the safety of a boat on the lake. The greatest attraction of Periyar, however are the herds of wild elephants that come down to play in the lake (Wild life viewing is always dependent on one's good fortune). Overnight stay at the Hotel.
Sightseeing:- visit periyar wild life sanctuary where you can see wild elephant, boar, deer, the great Indian tiger and more, mullaperiyar dam and spice plantations tour where one can shop exotic spices
Distance between Munnar to Thekkady is 125 Kms / 3 Hours by road

itinerary.title: Day 5 :(Alleppey)Thekkady to Alleppey Houseboat
itinerary.text:
Morning leave for Alleppey to enjoy a boat cruise tour in Alleppey Houseboat. Rest of the day at leisure on the House Boat which is world's major tourist attraction. Sit back and relax while the boat cruises through the narrow serene backwater canals of Alleppey. We can see here in breathing green, the village slumbers by the Vembanad Lake. On cruise scenery flashes up vivid contrasts of lush green and deep blues. As the boat glider along the gorgeous green of the fringed palms the ripples in the blue water blend in to little wavelets. Lunch, Evening Tea/ Coffee with snacks, dinner all are provided inside the houseboat. Overnight stay will provide on House Boat.Note:• The cruise commences at 1230 hrs with lunch served on board and continues till dusk. At dusk the boat will anchor in a wide waterway or lake for the night (The backwaters close to boat traffic at dusk as the fisherman lay their nets in the backwaters. Other boats are not allowed to ply in the backwaters after dusk. On the following day the cruise commences again after breakfast and the guest will be dropped at Alleppey by 0900Hrs. Overnight stay at hotel.
Houseboat check in at 12Noon and cruises till 5PM, Boat will be anchored till 8AM and cruises till 9AM for checkout
For A/C Houseboat, A/C will be operating from 9PM till 6AM only (All houseboat related inclusions are applicable only if the Itinerary is including Houseboat stay)
Cruise Time : 6 hrs.

Boarding @ : 12.00 pm

itinerary.text: After breakfast on board, the houseboat returns to the Alleppey jetty around 9 am. Check out and drive to Cochin (about 55 km, 1.5–2 hours). Depending on your travel time, you can stop at Fort Kochi to see the Chinese fishing nets and St. Francis Church. Our driver then drops you at Cochin airport or railway station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Grand Himachal with Mata Vaishno Devi Tour
name: Grand Himachal with Mata Vaishno Devi Tour
page_title: Grand Himachal with Mata Vaishno Devi Tour 12 Nights / 13 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Experience an unforgettable 13-day journey through Himachal Pradesh and Mata Vaishno Devi. This grand tour includes visits to Shimla, Manali, Dharamshala, and Amritsar, culminating in a spiritual visit to the Mata Vaishno Devi shrine.
cities: Shimla-2Day - Manali-3Day - Dharamshala-1Day - Dalhousie-1Day - Katra-2Day - Amritsar-1Day - Chandigarh-1Day - Delhi-2Day

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Shimla)Arrival Delhi & Delhi to Shimla
itinerary.text: Our driver meets you in Delhi for the drive to Shimla (about 380 km, 9 hours), the summer capital of British India. The road climbs from the plains through Chandigarh and the Shivalik hills. After checking in at your hotel in Shimla, the rest of the day is free; in the evening, take a walk on the Mall Road and the Ridge. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Shimla)Shimla: Full day sightseeing
itinerary.text: Today breakfast proceed for in and around sightseeing of SHIMLA, visit KUFRI, India's one of the best holiday paradise Kufri in Shimla is beautifully tucked on an altitude of 2,622 meter. The place is a tourist hotspot for its awesome scenic and sports activities. Evening free to stroll in the famous shopping place of Shimla town - “THE MALL & THE RIDGE” This large open space in the heart of town presents excellent views of the mountain ranges. Also visit Jakhoo Temple and Hanuman Temple. Shimla's landmarks - the neo- gothic structure of Christ Church (built in 1850's) and the neo - Tudor library building - are worth seeing. Overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Manali)Shimla to Kullu Manali
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Shimla to Manali (about 280 km, 9–10 hours) through the Kullu valley. On the way, see Sundernagar lake, the Pandoh dam on the Beas river and the Vaishno Devi temple near Kullu. The road follows the Beas through gorges and orchards. On arrival in Manali, check in at your hotel. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Manali)Manali - Local sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast local sightseeing of Manali “HADIMBA TEMPLE” Built in 1553 with a superbly crafted four tiered pagoda roof, it is famous for its exquisitely carved doorway . “CLUB HOUSE” The Club House with its comprehensive facilities that include a roller skating rink, an auditorium, billiards rooms, a library, a bar and restaurant makes wonderful outing for the day.” Tibetan Monastery, Mall Road, Van Vihar, and “VASHIST” Well known for its hot Sulphur springs. There are old temples dedicated to the sage Vashisth and to Lord Rama. Also visit Marhi, Rahalla Falls, Nehru Kund (Cold Water Spring-Named by Late PM Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru). Return back to hotel. Overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Manali)Manali to Excursion to Rohtang Pass (Snow Point)
itinerary.text:
Today enjoy excursion to Rohtang Pass also called Snow point- enjoy the beauty of year round snow caped mountains.Tourists can enjoy Snow Scooter, Ski Ride, mountain biking. Famous tourist spot Rohtang Pass is closed during Jan to April month due to heavy glaciers all around and so tourist activities can be spotted in Solang Valley during that period. Overnight Manali.
Note :Rohtang Pass will be closed on Tuesday. ( Rohtang Pass Sightseeing is not included from 15th May 2015 onwards. It will be chargeable extra payable directly by the guest)

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Dharamshala)Manali to Dharamshala - Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text:
Travel by surface to Mc Leodganj (Dharamsala), magnificently set to the background of the Dhauldhar mountains and the seat of his Holiness, the Dalai Lama, the leader of the Tibetans, since 1960. On arrival check in at hotel. Evening half day city tour visiting Dal Lake, Church, Bhagsu Nag Temple and Tibetan Monastery. Overnight at hotel.
Distance between Manali to Dharamshala is 240 Kms / 7 Hours by road

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Dalhousie)Dharamshala to Dalhousie
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Dharamshala to Dalhousie (about 130 km, 4 hours). Dalhousie is a hill station spread over five hills, with colonial-era churches and views of the Dhauladhar range. After checking in, the rest of the day is free to walk along the Mall, see Gandhi Chowk and St. John's Church, and enjoy the small town. Overnight stay in Dalhousie.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Dalhousie)Dalhousie sightseeing and Khajjiar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Khajjiar (about 24 km), a wide green meadow ringed by deodar forests, with a small lake and the Khajji Nag temple. It is often called the "mini Switzerland of India". Enjoy the mountain views from Lakkar Mandi on the way. Optional activities such as pony rides are paid locally. Return to Dalhousie in the evening for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 9 : (Katra)Dalhousie to Katra
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Dalhousie to Katra (about 260 km, 8 hours), the base town for the Mata Vaishno Devi yatra in the Trikuta hills. After checking in at your hotel, register for the yatra slip if needed and rest for the climb the next day. The evening is free to see the busy Katra market. Overnight stay in Katra.

itinerary.title: Day 10 : (Katra)Mata Vaishno Devi darshan
itinerary.text: After breakfast, begin the 13 km trek from Katra to the holy cave of Mata Vaishno Devi. You can walk, or hire a pony or palki from the shrine board; a helicopter service to Sanjhichhat is also available, at your own cost. After darshan, trek back down to Katra in the evening, sharing the journey with fellow pilgrims. "Jai Mata Di". Overnight stay in Katra.

itinerary.title: Day 11 : (Amritsar)Katra to Amritsar via Wagah Border & Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Katra to Amritsar (about 260 km, 5–6 hours). On arrival, go directly to the Wagah border to watch the Beating Retreat ceremony between India and Pakistan. Then check in at your hotel and, in the evening, visit the Golden Temple, the holiest shrine of the Sikhs, beautifully lit at night. Overnight stay in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Day 12 : (Chandigarh)Amritsar to Chandigarh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Jallianwala Bagh near the Golden Temple, then drive to Chandigarh (about 230 km, 5 hours). In the evening, visit the Rock Garden, created by Nek Chand from recycled materials, and Sukhna Lake, a popular place for an evening walk. Chandigarh, planned by Le Corbusier, is known for its green avenues. Overnight stay in Chandigarh.

itinerary.title: Day 13 : (Delhi)Chandigarh to Delhi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Chandigarh and drive back to Delhi (about 250 km, 4–5 hours). Our driver drops you at the railway station or airport in Delhi for your onward journey. The tour ends here, with memories of the hills of Himachal, the darshan of Mata Vaishno Devi and the Golden Temple.

title: Haridwar with Mussoorie and Corbett
name: Haridwar with Mussoorie and Corbett
page_title: Haridwar with Mussoorie and Corbett 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Explore the spiritual city of Haridwar, scenic beauty of Mussoorie, and wildlife of Corbett with our 6-day tour package. Visit famous temples, enjoy trekking, and spot exotic wildlife in Uttarakhand's most popular destinations.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Haridwar)Delhi to Haridwar ( 230 Kms - 7 Hours)
itinerary.text: Our driver picks you up in Delhi, or at the Haridwar railway station if you arrive by train, for the drive to Haridwar (about 230 km, 6–7 hours). After checking in at your hotel, visit the ashrams and temples of this holy town on the Ganga: Shivanand and Geeta Ashram, and the Mansa Devi and Chandi Devi temples, reached by cable car. In the evening, join the Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri, when hundreds of lamps are floated on the river. Overnight stay in Haridwar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Mussoorie)Haridwar to Mussoorie ( 90 Kms - 3 Hours)
itinerary.text:
Haridwar to Rishikesh ( 30 Kms - 1 Hour)
After breakfast Check out to hotel and depart to Rishikesh visiting Ram Jhoola, Laxman Jhoola, Trambakeshwar Temple and Geeta Bhawan.
Rishikesh to Dehradun ( 20 Kms - 1 Hour)
Next proceed to Dehradun visiting Sheshtradhara.
Dehradun to Mussoorie ( 40 Kms - 2 Hour)
Proceed to Mussoorie visiting Sheshtradhara. Evening arrive in Mussoorie & check in at your hotel. Evening at leisure. Overnight at the hotel
Distance between Haridwar to Mussoorie is 100 Kms (3.5 hours) by road

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Mussoorie)Mussoorie Local Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast proceed to visit famous Kemtey fall is 15Kms approx. from Mussoorie. It is popular tourists point in Mussoorie. Cloud Ends is 7Kms approx. from Mussoorie. It is hightest point of Mussorie offering awesome view to tourists. Camels Back Road is around 3Kms from Mussoorie. As name suggests rocks are shaped like a hump of camel at the end of road. Gun Hill Point is second highest point in Mussoorie. It is also accessible by a cable car. It offers complete view of Mussoorie. Lal Tibba (Red Hills) is located 6Kms from Mussoorie. If is famous among tourists to view sunset and sunrise.Also visit mall road. Back to the hotel. Overnight at Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Corbett)Mussoorie to Corbett
itinerary.text:
After breakfast check out from hotel then drive to Corbett National Park. The park was named after Jim Corbett, the legendary hunter-naturalist turned author and photographer who spent most years of his life in this area and helped set up this park. Check-in to your hotel/resort. Evening free for sightseeing covering Garjia temple and Corbett fall. Dinner and overnight stay in Corbett.
Distance between Mussoorie to Corbett is 270 Kms & 8 Hours drive approx.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Corbett)Corbett Park to Jeep Safari
itinerary.text:
Early morning enjoy jungle safari at the Corbett National Park (at your own cost). Return to the resort for breakfast. In the afternoon, visit Corbett Wildlife Museum, Dhikala which offers an awesome uninterrupted panoramic view of the valley. Back to the resort. Dinner and overnight at the hotel.
Corbett Tiger Reserve:- India's first national park, cradled in the foothills of the Himalayas at 3300 feet asl, spreads over an area of 520 sq km. The magnificent Ramganga River flows through the entire length of the Park. Corbett has the highest density of tiger in India. Other carnivores include the leopard, elephant, bear, deer. Basking along the banks of the Ramganga are the slender snouted gharial and the marsh crocodile. There are watch towers, elephant safaris and jeep safaris for wildlife viewing.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Delhi)Corbett to Delhi( 290 Kms - 8 Hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel near Jim Corbett National Park and drive back to Delhi (about 290 km, 8 hours). On arrival, our driver drops you at the airport or railway station for your onward journey. The tour ends here, with memories of the Ganga at Haridwar, the hills of Mussoorie and the forests of Corbett.

name: Mussoorie with Nainital Almora and Jim Corbett

description: Explore the Queen of Hills, Mussoorie, the Lake City, Nainital, the Cultural Hub, Almora, and the Wildlife Paradise, Jim Corbett National Park with our 7-day tour package..

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Mussoorie)Arrive Delhi to Mussoorie ( 310 Kms - 9 Hours)
itinerary.text: Our driver meets you in Delhi for the drive to Mussoorie (about 310 km, 8–9 hours) via Dehradun, climbing into the Garhwal hills. Arrive in the late afternoon and check in at your hotel. Mussoorie, the "Queen of the Hills", has wide views of the Doon valley and the snow peaks. The evening is free to walk along the Mall Road, lined with shops and cafés. Overnight stay in Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Mussoorie)Mussoorie Local Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast proceed to visit famous Kemtey fall is 15Kms approx. from Mussoorie. It is popular tourists point in Mussoorie. Cloud Ends is 7Kms approx. from Mussoorie. It is hightest point of Mussorie offering awesome view to tourists. Camels Back Road is around 3Kms from Mussoorie. As name suggests rocks are shaped like a hump of camel at the end of road. Gun Hill Point is second highest point in Mussoorie. It is also accessible by a cable car. It offers complete view of Mussoorie. Lal Tibba (Red Hills) is located 6Kms from Mussoorie. If is famous among tourists to view sunset and sunrise.Also visit mall road. Back to the hotel. Overnight at Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Corbett)Mussoorie to Corbett
itinerary.text:
After breakfast check out from hotel then drive to Corbett National Park. The park was named after Jim Corbett, the legendary hunter-naturalist turned author and photographer who spent most years of his life in this area and helped set up this park. Check-in to your hotel/resort. Evening free for sightseeing covering Garjia temple and Corbett fall. Dinner and overnight stay in Corbett.
Distance between Mussoorie to Corbett is 270 Kms & 8 Hours drive approx.

itinerary.title: Day 4 :(Almora)Corbett to Almora (170 Kms/6 Hrs)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Corbett to Almora (about 170 km, 6 hours), a hill town on a ridge at about 5,400 ft in the Kumaon hills, with wide views of the Himalaya. After checking in, the rest of the day is free to explore on your own: the old Lala Bazaar with its wooden-fronted shops, the Nanda Devi temple and the sunset views from the ridge. Overnight stay in Almora.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Nainital)Almora to Nainital( 80 Kms - 2.5 Hours)
itinerary.text:
After breakfast check out and drive to Nainital. On arrival, check in to the hotel. After refreshing yourself at the hotel in Nainital, go on a sightseeing tour, beginning with boating on the famous Naini Lake (at your own cost) and visit to the holy Naina Devi Temple. After that, visit famous tourist spots like Naina Peak, SnowView and Lands End etc. In the evening, enjoy shopping at the Mall Road. Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel.
Note:- Tempo traveller or higher seating vehicle are allowed upto Nainital Parking only. For local sightseeing in Nainital guest has to take local vehicle for sightseeing from Nainital Union on direct payment basis.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Nainital)Nainital Lake Tour

As name suggests is a group of seven lakes interconnected, Naukuchiatal is about 30 kilometers from Nainital. It is 9 cornered lake. Drive back to Hotel, Dinner & Overnight stay at Hotel.

itinerary.text:
Morning drive to drive to Ranikhet, on arrival Ranikhet check in at the hotel. Later visit local sight seeing i.e. Haidakhan Babaji Temple (4kms.), Chaubatia Gardens(10kms.), Bhalu Dam (3kms.), Jhula Devi Temple (7kms.), Mankameshwar Temple, Kalika Temple(5kms.) Tarikhet Village (8kms.), Majhkhali (13kms.) etc. Dinner & Overnight stay at Hotel.
Ranikhet:- Ranikhet reflects the very best of the heavenly Himalayas, their lush green forests, majestic mountain peaks, exotic plant life and attractive wild life. To see nature and its elements in full harmony, the right place to be is Ranikhet. According to a popular belief, this spot had won the heart of Rani Padmini, queen of Raja Sudhardev. She chose this scenic place to be her abode and since then, it has come to be known as Ranikhet, literally “Queen's Field". At an altitude of 1829mtres, above sea level, the invigorating mountain breeze, the singing of birds, the panoramic view of the Himalayas - the sights, sounds and smells leave the onlooker spellbound. During the rains, flowers sprout up every where in rainbow colours, branches of tress stoop with ripened fruits and sunlight peeping through the mist and clouds, endow an enchanting effect all across Ranikhet. As winter comes, the softly falling snowflakes cover the environs in sheets of pure whiteness.
Distance between Nainital to Ranikhet is 70 Kms / 2.5 Hours by road

itinerary.title: Day 4 :(Corbett)Ranikhet to Corbett( 100 Kms - 3 Hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Jim Corbett National Park (about 100 km, 3 hours). The park is named after Jim Corbett, the hunter-naturalist turned author who spent much of his life here and helped set it up; it is India's oldest national park and home of the Bengal tiger. After checking in at your hotel, visit the Garjia Devi temple on a rock in the Kosi river in the evening. Overnight stay in Corbett.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Corbett)Corbett to Delhi( 290 Kms - 8 Hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel near Jim Corbett National Park and drive back to Delhi (about 290 km, 7–8 hours) through the Terai and the plains of western Uttar Pradesh. On arrival, our driver drops you at the airport or railway station for your onward journey. The tour ends here, with memories of the Kumaon hills and the forests of Corbett.

title: Serene Tour to Singapore with Thailand
name: Serene Tour to Singapore with Thailand
page_title: Serene Tour to Singapore with Thailand 8 Nights / 9 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Experience a serene tour to Singapore and Thailand with our 8 nights 9 days package. Explore the beauty of Singapore and Thailand with our expertly curated itinerary, including Universal Studio, Sunway Lagoon Park, Phi Phi Island Tour, and Safari World Marine Park.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Singapore)Arrival in Singapore
itinerary.text: Welcome to Singapore. On arrival at Changi Airport, our local representative meets you and transfers you privately to your hotel, the ibis Styles Singapore on Macpherson. The rest of the day is free. In the evening you can visit Marina Bay to see the city skyline and the Spectra light and water show (free), or walk along Clarke Quay. Overnight stay in Singapore.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Singapore)Singapore Sightseeing
itinerary.text: In the morning, get ready and you will be transferred to Universal Studio for a day tour. Experience cutting-edge rides, shows, and attractions based on your favourite blockbuster films and television series, including TRANSFORMERS The Ride: The Ultimate 3D Battle, Shrek, Madagascar: A Crate Adventure, Jurassic Park Rapids Adventure.Later by the end of the day, you will be transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kuala Lumpur)Singapore-Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and transfer to the coach terminal for the coach to Kuala Lumpur (about 5–6 hours); the one-way coach transfer is included. On arrival, our local representative meets you and transfers you to the Ibis Styles Kuala Lumpur Fraser Business Park. The rest of the day is free; in the evening you can see the Petronas Twin Towers lit up. Overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Kuala Lumpur)Sunway Lagoon Theme Park
itinerary.text:
After breakfast head for sightseeing tour of the famous Sunway Lagoon Theme park which is one of the famous tourist attractions in Singapore.
The park is separated into different themed lands in Wild West and the Waters of Africa, each boasting their own exciting attractions. Splash in for wet rides on the Voodoo Adventure River and the heart-stopping adrenaline rush rides from the toboggans.
Back on dry land, try the roller coaster, the inverted pirate ship or some of the other many attractions. Later by evening return back and overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Phuket)Kuala Lumpur-Phuket
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight to Phuket. On arrival, our local representative meets you and transfers you to the Ibis Styles Phuket. The rest of the day is free to relax on the beach or explore Patong's lively Bangla Road in the evening. Overnight stay in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Phuket)Phi Phi Island Tour
itinerary.text:
The next day is planned for a full day Phi Phi Island Tour by Speed Boat. Phi Phi Island is located just 45 minutes by speedboat from Phuket that offer a great laid back tropical lifestyle. Soak up the sun, go beach hopping or simply enjoy the great outdoors in some of the most beautiful scenery in Asia.
Classic white sandy beaches, surrounded by impressive limestone cliffs and sunlit crystal clear water, Phi Phi actually consist of two islands, Phi Phi Don and Phi Phi Ley. Explore the beauty of the place and enjoy the day.
You will be transferred back for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Bangkok)Phuket-Bangkok
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight to Bangkok. On arrival, our local representative meets you and transfers you to the Ibis Styles Bangkok Sukhumvit 50. The rest of the day is free; in the evening you can explore a night market or take a river cruise on the Chao Phraya at your own cost. Overnight stay in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Bangkok)Bangkok Sight seeing
itinerary.text:
After breakfast proceed to full day safari of world marine park which is one of the famous attractions in Bangkok. No one can resist the excitement of indulging in a day full of experiences and activities at safari world & marine park. Witness the majestic wild creatures like African lion and Bengal tiger on an 8 km long drive, then pass through the most beautiful and fun loving animals like Orangutan, dolphins and colorful bird species. Enjoy watching the Dolphins performance
The park is unique for as it blends the Wild & Herbivorous Animals with the Exotic Fresh Water and Oceanic Life.The diverse species of animals will amaze you who are living in this natural like habitat.
Mesmerize yourself by witnessing the friendly Dolphins performing somersaults
Then enjoy Orang Utan Boxing Show - Man's closest cousins take centre stage as they tickle you with their keen sense of humour and dazzle you with their mathematical gifts.

itinerary.title: Day 9 : (Bangkok)Departure from Bangkok
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Bangkok. Depending on your flight time, you may have a little time for last-minute shopping. You are then transferred privately to the airport for your flight home; return airport transfers on a private basis are included. The tour ends here, with memories of Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Phuket and Bangkok.

title: Shimla Manali with Dharamshala Dalhousie and Amritsar
name: Shimla Manali with Dharamshala Dalhousie and Amritsar
page_title: Shimla Manali with Dharamshala Dalhousie and Amritsar 8 Nights / 9 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Embark on a 9-day tour through Shimla, Manali, Dharamshala, Dalhousie, and Amritsar. Experience the best of Himachal Pradesh and Punjab, including visits to Rohtang Pass, Khajjiar, and the Golden Temple. Ideal for travelers seeking a complete North Indian adventure.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Shimla)Arrival Delhi & Delhi to Shimla
itinerary.text: Our driver meets you in Delhi (about 380 km, 9 hours) for the drive up to Shimla, the summer capital of British India, through the Shivalik foothills and pine forests. After checking in at your hotel, the rest of the day is free. In the evening, walk along the Mall Road and the Ridge, with Christ Church, Scandal Point and views over the valleys, and plenty of cafés and shops. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Shimla)Shimla: Full day sightseeing
itinerary.text: Today breakfast proceed for in and around sightseeing of SHIMLA, visit KUFRI, India's one of the best holiday paradise Kufri in Shimla is beautifully tucked on an altitude of 2,622 meter. The place is a tourist hotspot for its awesome scenic and sports activities. Evening free to stroll in the famous shopping place of Shimla town - “THE MALL & THE RIDGE” This large open space in the heart of town presents excellent views of the mountain ranges. Also visit Jakhoo Temple and Hanuman Temple. Shimla's landmarks - the neo- gothic structure of Christ Church (built in 1850's) and the neo - Tudor library building - are worth seeing. Overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Manali)Shimla to Kullu Manali
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Shimla to Manali (about 280 km, 9–10 hours) through the Kullu valley. On the way, see Sundernagar lake, the Pandoh dam on the Beas river and the Vaishno Devi temple near Kullu. The road follows the Beas through gorges and apple orchards. On arrival in Manali, check in at your hotel and rest. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Manali)Manali to Excursion to Rohtang Pass (Snow Point)
itinerary.text:
Today enjoy excursion to Rohtang Pass also called Snow point- enjoy the beauty of year round snow caped mountains.Tourists can enjoy Snow Scooter, Ski Ride, mountain biking. Famous tourist spot Rohtang Pass is closed during Jan to April month due to heavy glaciers all around and so tourist activities can be spotted in Solang Valley during that period. Evening visit “HADIMBA TEMPLE” Built in 1553 with a superbly crafted four tiered pagoda roof, it is famous for its exquisitely carved doorway . “CLUB HOUSE” The Club House with its comprehensive facilities that include a roller skating rink, an auditorium, billiards rooms, a library, a bar and restaurant makes wonderful outing for the day.” Tibetan Monastery, Van Vihar, and “VASHIST” Well known for its hot springs. There are old temples dedicated to the sage Vashisth and to Lord Rama. Overnight Manali.
Note :Rohtang Pass will be closed on Tuesday. ( Rohtang Pass Sightseeing is not included from 15th May 2015 onwards. It will be chargeable extra payable directly by the guest)

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Dharamshala)Manali to Dharamshala - Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text:
Travel by surface to Mc Leodganj (Dharamsala), magnificently set to the background of the Dhauldhar mountains and the seat of his Holiness, the Dalai Lama, the leader of the Tibetans, since 1960. On arrival check in at hotel. Evening half day city tour visiting Dal Lake, Church, Bhagsu Nag Temple and Tibetan Monastery. Overnight at hotel.
Distance between Manali to Dharamshala is 240 Kms / 7 Hours by road

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Dalhousie)Dharamshala to Dalhousie
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Dharamshala to Dalhousie (about 130 km, 4 hours). Dalhousie is a hill station spread over five hills, with colonial-era churches and views of the Dhauladhar range. After checking in, the rest of the day is free to walk along the Mall, see Gandhi Chowk and St. John's Church, and enjoy the small town. Overnight stay in Dalhousie.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Dalhousie)Dalhousie Local Sightseeing - Khajjiar Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Khajjiar (about 24 km), a wide green meadow ringed by deodar forests, with a small lake and the Khajji Nag temple. It is often called the "mini Switzerland of India". Enjoy the mountain views from Lakkar Mandi on the way. Optional activities such as pony rides are paid locally. Return to Dalhousie in the evening for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Amritsar)Dalhousie to Amritsar via Wagah Border
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Dalhousie to Amritsar (about 200 km, 5–6 hours) through Pathankot. In the afternoon, go to the Wagah border to watch the Beating Retreat ceremony between India and Pakistan. Then check in at your hotel and, in the evening, visit the Golden Temple, the holiest shrine of the Sikhs, beautifully lit at night. Overnight stay in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Day 9 : (Delhi)Amritsar to Delhi
itinerary.text: Visit the Golden Temple again in the early morning if you wish, and the Jallianwala Bagh memorial nearby. After breakfast, check out and drive to Delhi (about 450 km, 8–9 hours) via Chandigarh. On arrival, our driver drops you at the railway station or airport for your onward journey. If you prefer, you can instead be dropped at Amritsar airport or railway station. The tour ends here.
